flavorText.ruby-sapphire: TREECKO has small hooks on the bottom of its feet that enable it to scale vertical walls. This POKéMON attacks by slamming foes with its thick tail.
flavorText.emerald: It makes its nest in a giant tree in the forest. It ferociously guards against anything nearing its territory. It is said to be the protector of the forest’s trees.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It quickly scales even vertical walls. It senses humidity with its tail to predict the next day’s weather.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: The soles of its feet are covered by countless tiny spikes, enabling it to walk on walls and ceilings.
flavorText.platinum: The soles of its feet are covered by countless tiny spikes, enabling it to walk on walls and ceilings.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: Small hooks on the bottom of its feet catch on walls and ceilings. That is how it can hang from above.
flavorText.black-white: The soles of its feet are covered by countless tiny spikes, enabling it to walk on walls and ceilings.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: The soles of its feet are covered by countless tiny spikes, enabling it to walk on walls and ceilings.
flavorText.x-y: It quickly scales even vertical walls. It senses humidity with its tail to predict the next day’s weather.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Treecko has small hooks on the bottom of its feet that enable it to scale vertical walls. This Pokémon attacks by slamming foes with its thick tail.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: The leaves growing out of GROVYLE’s body are convenient for camouflaging it from enemies in the forest. This POKéMON is a master at climbing trees in jungles.
flavorText.emerald: Leaves grow out of this POKéMON’s body. They help obscure a GROVYLE from the eyes of its enemies while it is in a thickly overgrown forest.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: Its strongly developed thigh muscles give it astounding agility and jumping performance.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It lives in dense jungles. While closing in on its prey, it leaps from branch to branch.
flavorText.platinum: It lives in dense jungles. While closing in on its prey, it leaps from branch to branch.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It leaps from tree branch to tree branch quite swiftly. It shows astounding agility.
flavorText.black-white: It lives in dense jungles. While closing in on its prey, it leaps from branch to branch.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It lives in dense jungles. While closing in on its prey, it leaps from branch to branch.
flavorText.x-y: Its strongly developed thigh muscles give it astounding agility and jumping performance.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: The leaves growing out of Grovyle’s body are convenient for camouflaging it from enemies in the forest. This Pokémon is a master at climbing trees in jungles.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: The leaves growing on SCEPTILE’s body are very sharp edged. This POKéMON is very agile - it leaps all over the branches of trees and jumps on its foe from above or behind.
flavorText.emerald: In the jungle, its power is without equal. This POKéMON carefully grows trees and plants. It regulates its body temperature by basking in sunlight.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: The leaves on its forelegs are as sharp as swords. It agilely leaps about the branches of trees to strike.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: The leaves that grow on its arms can slice down thick trees. It is without peer in jungle combat.
flavorText.platinum: The leaves that grow on its arms can slice down thick trees. It is without peer in jungle combat.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It agilely leaps about the jungle and uses the sharp leaves on its arms to strike its prey.
flavorText.black-white: The leaves that grow on its arms can slice down thick trees. It is without peer in jungle combat.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: The leaves that grow on its arms can slice down thick trees. It is without peer in jungle combat.
flavorText.x-y: The leaves that grow on its arms can slice down thick trees. It is without peer in jungle combat.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: The leaves growing on Sceptile’s body are very sharp edged. This Pokémon is very agile—it leaps all over the branches of trees and jumps on its foe from above or behind.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: TORCHIC sticks with its TRAINER, following behind with unsteady steps. This POKéMON breathes fire of over 1,800 degrees F, including fireballs that leave the foe scorched black.
flavorText.emerald: If attacked, it strikes back by spitting balls of fire it forms in its stomach. A TORCHIC dislikes darkness because it can’t see its surroundings.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It has a flame sac inside its belly that perpetually burns. It feels warm if it is hugged.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: A fire burns inside, so it feels very warm to hug. It launches fireballs of 1,800 degrees F.
flavorText.platinum: A fire burns inside, so it feels very warm to hug. It launches fireballs of 1,800 degrees F.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: Inside its body is a place where it keeps a small flame. Hug it! It will be as warm as a hot-water bottle.
flavorText.black-white: A fire burns inside, so it feels very warm to hug. It launches fireballs of 1,800 degrees F.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: A fire burns inside, so it feels very warm to hug. It launches fireballs of 1,800 degrees F.
flavorText.x-y: It has a flame sac inside its belly that perpetually burns. It feels warm if it is hugged.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Torchic sticks with its Trainer, following behind with unsteady steps. This Pokémon breathes fire of over 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit, including fireballs that leave the foe scorched black.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: COMBUSKEN toughens up its legs and thighs by running through fields and mountains. This POKéMON’s legs possess both speed and power, enabling it to dole out ten kicks in one second.
flavorText.emerald: It lashes out with 10 kicks per second. Its strong fighting instinct compels it to keep up its offensive until the opponent gives up.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It boosts its concentration by emitting harsh cries. Its kicks have outstanding destructive power.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: Its kicking mastery lets it loose 10 kicks per second. It emits sharp cries to intimidate foes.
flavorText.platinum: Its kicking mastery lets it loose 10 kicks per second. It emits sharp cries to intimidate foes.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: During a battle, the hot flame in its body increases. Its kicks have outstanding destructive power.
flavorText.black-white: Its kicking mastery lets it loose 10 kicks per second. It emits sharp cries to intimidate foes.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Its kicking mastery lets it loose 10 kicks per second. It emits sharp cries to intimidate foes.
flavorText.x-y: Its kicking mastery lets it loose 10 kicks per second. It emits sharp cries to intimidate foes.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Combusken toughens up its legs and thighs by running through fields and mountains. This Pokémon’s legs possess both speed and power, enabling it to dole out 10 kicks in one second.

flavorText.platinum: Flames spout from its wrists, enveloping its knuckles. Its punches scorch its foes.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It can clear a 30-story building in a leap. Its fiery punches scorch its foes.
flavorText.black-white: Flames spout from its wrists, enveloping its knuckles. Its punches scorch its foes.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Flames spout from its wrists, enveloping its knuckles. Its punches scorch its foes.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: In battle, BLAZIKEN blows out intense flames from its wrists and attacks foes courageously. The stronger the foe, the more intensely this POKéMON’s wrists burn.
flavorText.emerald: It learns martial arts that use punches and kicks. Every several years, its old feathers burn off, and new, supple feathers grow back in their place.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: When facing a tough foe, it looses flames from its wrists. Its powerful legs let it jump clear over buildings.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: Flames spout from its wrists, enveloping its knuckles. Its punches scorch its foes.
flavorText.x-y: It can clear a 30-story building in a leap. Its fiery punches scorch its foes.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: In battle, Blaziken blows out intense flames from its wrists and attacks foes courageously. The stronger the foe, the more intensely this Pokémon’s wrists burn.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: The fin on MUDKIP’s head acts as highly sensitive radar. Using this fin to sense movements of water and air, this POKéMON can determine what is taking place around it without using its eyes.
flavorText.emerald: On land, it can powerfully lift large boulders by planting its four feet and heaving. It sleeps by burying itself in soil at the water’s edge.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: Its large tail fin propels it through water with powerful acceleration. It is strong in spite of its size.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: To alert it, the fin on its head senses the flow of water. It has the strength to heft boulders.
flavorText.platinum: To alert it, the fin on its head senses the flow of water. It has the strength to heft boulders.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: Its power can crush boulders. It rests by covering itself with mud at the bottom of a river.
flavorText.black-white: To alert it, the fin on its head senses the flow of water. It has the strength to heft boulders.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: To alert it, the fin on its head senses the flow of water. It has the strength to heft boulders.
flavorText.x-y: Its large tail fin propels it through water with powerful acceleration. It is strong in spite of its size.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: The fin on Mudkip’s head acts as highly sensitive radar. Using this fin to sense movements of water and air, this Pokémon can determine what is taking place around it without using its eyes.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: The surface of MARSHTOMP’s body is enveloped by a thin, sticky film that enables it to live on land. This POKéMON plays in mud on beaches when the ocean tide is low.
flavorText.emerald: Its toughened hind legs enable it to stand upright. Because it weakens if its skin dries out, it replenishes fluids by playing in mud.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It is at its best when on muddy ground with poor footing. It quickly overwhelms foes struggling in mud.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: Its sturdy legs give it sure footing, even in mud. It burrows into dirt to sleep.
flavorText.platinum: Its sturdy legs give it sure footing, even in mud. It burrows into dirt to sleep.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: Living on muddy ground that provides poor footing has made its legs sturdy.
flavorText.black-white: Its sturdy legs give it sure footing, even in mud. It burrows into dirt to sleep.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Its sturdy legs give it sure footing, even in mud. It burrows into dirt to sleep.
flavorText.x-y: Its sturdy legs give it sure footing, even in mud. It burrows into dirt to sleep.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: The surface of Marshtomp’s body is enveloped by a thin, sticky film that enables it to live on land. This Pokémon plays in mud on beaches when the ocean tide is low.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: SWAMPERT is very strong. It has enough power to easily drag a boulder weighing more than a ton. This POKéMON also has powerful vision that lets it see even in murky water.
flavorText.emerald: If it senses the approach of a storm and a tidal wave, it protects its seaside nest by piling up boulders. It swims as fast as a jet ski.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: Its arms are rock-hard. With one swing, they can batter down its foe. It makes its nest on beautiful beaches.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It can swim while towing a large ship. It bashes down foes with a swing of its thick arms.
flavorText.platinum: It can swim while towing a large ship. It bashes down foes with a swing of its thick arms.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: Its arms are hard as rock. With one swing, it can break a boulder into pieces.
flavorText.black-white: It can swim while towing a large ship. It bashes down foes with a swing of its thick arms.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It can swim while towing a large ship. It bashes down foes with a swing of its thick arms.
flavorText.x-y: Its arms are hard as rock. With one swing, it can break a boulder into pieces.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Swampert is very strong. It has enough power to easily drag a boulder weighing more than a ton. This Pokémon also has powerful vision that lets it see even in murky water.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: At first sight, POOCHYENA takes a bite at anything that moves. This POKéMON chases after prey until the victim becomes exhausted. However, it may turn tail if the prey strikes back.
flavorText.emerald: It savagely threatens foes with bared fangs. It chases after fleeing targets tenaciously. It turns tail and runs, however, if the foe strikes back.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It has a very tenacious nature. Its acute sense of smell lets it chase a chosen prey without ever losing track.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: A Pokémon with a persistent nature, it chases its chosen prey until the prey becomes exhausted.
flavorText.platinum: A Pokémon with a persistent nature, it chases its chosen prey until the prey becomes exhausted.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It chases its prey until the victim becomes exhausted. However, it turns tail if the prey strikes back.
flavorText.black-white: A Pokémon with a persistent nature, it chases its chosen prey until the prey becomes exhausted.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: A Pokémon with a persistent nature, it chases its chosen prey until the prey becomes exhausted.
flavorText.x-y: A Pokémon with a persistent nature, it chases its chosen prey until the prey becomes exhausted.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: At first sight, Poochyena takes a bite at anything that moves. This Pokémon chases after prey until the victim becomes exhausted. However, it may turn tail if the prey strikes back.

flavorText.black-2-white-2: It chases down prey in a pack. It will never disobey the commands of a skilled Trainer.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: MIGHTYENA gives obvious signals when it is preparing to attack. It starts to growl deeply and then flattens its body. This POKéMON will bite savagely with its sharply pointed fangs.
flavorText.emerald: In the wild, MIGHTYENA live in a pack. They never defy their leader’s orders. They defeat foes with perfectly coordinated teamwork.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It will always obey the commands of a skilled TRAINER. Its behavior arises from its living in packs in ancient times.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It chases down prey in a pack. It will never disobey the commands of a skilled Trainer.
flavorText.platinum: It chases down prey in a pack. It will never disobey the commands of a skilled Trainer.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It chases down prey in a pack of around ten. They defeat foes with perfectly coordinated teamwork.
flavorText.black-white: It chases down prey in a pack. It will never disobey the commands of a skilled Trainer.
flavorText.x-y: It will always obey the commands of a skilled Trainer. Its behavior arises from its living in packs in ancient times.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Mightyena gives obvious signals when it is preparing to attack. It starts to growl deeply and then flattens its body. This Pokémon will bite savagely with its sharply pointed fangs.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: ZIGZAGOON restlessly wanders everywhere at all times. This POKéMON does so because it is very curious. It becomes interested in anything that it happens to see.
flavorText.emerald: Rubbing its nose against the ground, it always wanders about back and forth in search of something. It is distinguished by the zigzag footprints it leaves.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: A POKéMON with abundant curiosity. It shows an interest in everything, so it always zigs and zags.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It walks in zigzag fashion. It is good at finding items in the grass and even in the ground.
flavorText.platinum: It walks in zigzag fashion. It is good at finding items in the grass and even in the ground.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It gets interested in everything, which is why it zigs and zags. It is good at finding items.
flavorText.black-white: It walks in zigzag fashion. It is good at finding items in the grass and even in the ground.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It walks in zigzag fashion. It is good at finding items in the grass and even in the ground.
flavorText.x-y: It walks in zigzag fashion. It’s good at finding items in the grass and even in the ground.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Zigzagoon restlessly wanders everywhere at all times. This Pokémon does so because it is very curious. It becomes interested in anything that it happens to see.
flavorText.sword-shield: It marks its territory by rubbing its bristly fur on trees. This variety of Zigzagoon is friendlier and calmer than the kind native to Galar.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: LINOONE always runs full speed and only in straight lines. If facing an obstacle, it makes a right-angle turn to evade it. This POKéMON is very challenged by gently curving roads.
flavorText.emerald: It is exceedingly fast if it only has to run in a straight line. When it spots pond- dwelling prey underwater, it quickly leaps in and catches it with its sharp claws.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: When running in a straight line, it can top 60 miles per hour. However, it has a tough time with curved roads.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It charges prey at speeds over 60 mph. However, because it can only run straight, it often fails.
flavorText.platinum: It charges prey at speeds over 60 mph. However, because it can only run straight, it often fails.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: When running in a straight line, it can easily top 60 miles an hour. It has a tough time with curved roads.
flavorText.black-white: It charges prey at speeds over 60 mph. However, because it can only run straight, it often fails.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It charges prey at speeds over 60 mph. However, because it can only run straight, it often fails.
flavorText.x-y: When running in a straight line, it can easily top 60 miles an hour. It has a tough time with curved roads.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Linoone always runs full speed and only in straight lines. If facing an obstacle, it makes a right-angle turn to evade it. This Pokémon is very challenged by gently curving roads.
flavorText.sword-shield: Its fur is strong and supple. Shaving brushes made with shed Linoone hairs are highly prized.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: Using the spikes on its rear end, WURMPLE peels the bark off trees and feeds on the sap that oozes out. This POKéMON’s feet are tipped with suction pads that allow it to cling to glass without slipping.
flavorText.emerald: It sticks to tree branches and eats leaves. The thread it spits from its mouth, which becomes gooey when it touches air, slows the movement of its foes.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It lives amidst tall grass and in forests. When attacked, it resists by pointing its venomous spikes at the foe.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It loves to eat leaves. If it is attacked by a STARLY, it will defend itself with its spiked rear.
flavorText.platinum: Often targeted by bird Pokémon, it desperately resists by releasing poison from its tail spikes.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It lives among the tall grass and in forests. It repels attacks by raising up the spikes on its rear.
flavorText.black-white: Often targeted by bird Pokémon, it desperately resists by releasing poison from its tail spikes.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Often targeted by bird Pokémon, it desperately resists by releasing poison from its tail spikes.
flavorText.x-y: It loves to eat leaves. If it is attacked by a Starly, it will defend itself with its spiked rear.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Using the spikes on its rear end, Wurmple peels the bark off trees and feeds on the sap that oozes out. This Pokémon’s feet are tipped with suction pads that allow it to cling to glass without slipping.
flavorText.legends-arceus: Likes sap and is abundant in the wild. Why it evolves into various different forms is unknown. One cannot tell from a Wurmple's appearance which form it will take when it evolves.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: SILCOON tethers itself to a tree branch using silk to keep from falling. There, this POKéMON hangs quietly while it awaits evolution. It peers out of the silk cocoon through a small hole.
flavorText.emerald: It prepares for evolution using the energy it stored while it was a WURMPLE. It keeps watch over the surroundings with its two eyes.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It conserves its energy by moving as little as possible. It awaits evolution while drinking only a little rainwater.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It anchors itself by wrapping twigs with the silk from its body. It motionlessly awaits evolution.
flavorText.platinum: It wraps silk around the branches of a tree. It drinks rainwater on its silk while awaiting evolution.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: Having wrapped silk around the branches of a tree, it quiescently awaits evolution.
flavorText.black-white: It wraps silk around the branches of a tree. It drinks rainwater on its silk while awaiting evolution.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It wraps silk around the branches of a tree. It drinks rainwater on its silk while awaiting evolution.
flavorText.x-y: It wraps silk around the branches of a tree. It drinks rainwater on its silk while awaiting evolution.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Silcoon tethers itself to a tree branch using silk to keep from falling. There, this Pokémon hangs quietly while it awaits evolution. It peers out of the silk cocoon through a small hole.
flavorText.legends-arceus: Wraps itself in thin strings of silk while it stores energy for evolution. It can't extend its limbs and its movement is slow, but its eyes keep a sharp lookout—Silcoon is always on guard.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: BEAUTIFLY’s favorite food is the sweet pollen of flowers. If you want to see this POKéMON, just leave a potted flower by an open window. BEAUTIFLY is sure to come looking for pollen.
flavorText.emerald: Its colorfully patterned wings are its most prominent feature. It flies through flower-covered fields collecting pollen. It attacks ferociously when angered.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: Despite its appearance, it has an aggressive nature. It attacks by jabbing with its long, thin mouth.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It has an aggressive nature. It stabs prey with its long, narrow mouth to drain the prey’s fluids.
flavorText.platinum: Despite its looks, it is aggressive. It jabs with its long, thin mouth if disturbed while collecting pollen.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: Vibrantly patterned wings are its prominent feature. It sucks sweet flower nectar with its long mouth.
flavorText.black-white: Despite its looks, it is aggressive. It jabs with its long, thin mouth if disturbed while collecting pollen.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Despite its looks, it is aggressive. It jabs with its long, thin mouth if disturbed while collecting pollen.
flavorText.x-y: Vibrantly patterned wings are its prominent feature. It sucks sweet flower nectar with its long mouth.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Beautifly’s favorite food is the sweet pollen of flowers. If you want to see this Pokémon, just leave a potted flower by an open window. Beautifly is sure to come looking for pollen.
flavorText.legends-arceus: A colorful and incredibly beautiful but also greedy Pokémon. In an effort to keep its favorite food all to itself, it will chase away Combee as they try to gather nectar.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: CASCOON makes its protective cocoon by wrapping its body entirely with a fine silk from its mouth. Once the silk goes around its body, it hardens. This POKéMON prepares for its evolution inside the cocoon.
flavorText.emerald: To avoid detection by its enemies, it hides motionlessly beneath large leaves and in the gaps of branches. It also attaches dead leaves to its body for camouflage.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: Its body, which is made of soft silk, hardens over time. When cracks appear, evolution is near.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It is hot inside its cocoon. All the cells in its body create the energy for it to evolve.
flavorText.platinum: It never forgets any attack it endured while in the cocoon. After evolution, it seeks payback.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It endures attacks with patience, because the more pain before evolution, the sturdier it becomes.
flavorText.black-white: It never forgets any attack it endured while in the cocoon. After evolution, it seeks payback.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It never forgets any attack it endured while in the cocoon. After evolution, it seeks payback.
flavorText.x-y: Its body, which is made of soft silk, hardens over time. When cracks appear, evolution is near.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Cascoon makes its protective cocoon by wrapping its body entirely with a fine silk from its mouth. Once the silk goes around its body, it hardens. This Pokémon prepares for its evolution inside the cocoon.
flavorText.legends-arceus: The silk coating its body is thin but sufficiently strong. Cascoon's silk has a luster and texture superior to that of Silcoon's, and clothes made using Cascoon silk are regarded as top-notch.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: DUSTOX is instinctively drawn to light. Swarms of this POKéMON are attracted by the bright lights of cities, where they wreak havoc by stripping the leaves off roadside trees for food.
flavorText.emerald: It is a nocturnal POKéMON that flies from fields and mountains to the attraction of streetlights at night. It looses highly toxic powder from its wings.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It scatters horribly toxic dust when it senses danger. They tend to gather in the glow of streetlamps at night.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: A nocturnal Pokémon. Drawn by streetlights, they messily eat the leaves of trees lining boulevards.
flavorText.platinum: Toxic powder is scattered with each flap. At night, it is known to strip leaves off trees lining boulevards.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It scatters its fine dust all over when it is attacked. It is a nocturnal Pokémon.
flavorText.black-white: Toxic powder is scattered with each flap. At night, it is known to strip leaves off trees lining boulevards.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Toxic powder is scattered with each flap. At night, it is known to strip leaves off trees lining boulevards.
flavorText.x-y: A nocturnal Pokémon. Drawn by streetlights, they messily eat the leaves of trees lining boulevards.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Dustox is instinctively drawn to light. Swarms of this Pokémon are attracted by the bright lights of cities, where they wreak havoc by stripping the leaves off roadside trees for food.
flavorText.legends-arceus: Tends to be drawn to bonfires on dark nights. Difficult to chase away from settlements because of the way it scatters highly toxic scales.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: LOTAD live in ponds and lakes, where they float on the surface. It grows weak if its broad leaf dies. On rare occasions, this POKéMON travels on land in search of clean water.
flavorText.emerald: This POKéMON lives in ponds with clean water. It is known to ferry small POKéMON across ponds by carrying them on the broad leaf on its head.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It searches about for clean water. If it does not drink water for too long, the leaf on its head wilts.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It looks like an aquatic plant and serves as a ferry to Pokémon that can’t swim.
flavorText.platinum: It looks like an aquatic plant and serves as a ferry to Pokémon that can’t swim.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: Its leaf grew too large for it to live on land. That is how it began to live floating in the water.
flavorText.black-white: It looks like an aquatic plant and serves as a ferry to Pokémon that can’t swim.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It looks like an aquatic plant and serves as a ferry to Pokémon that can’t swim.
flavorText.x-y: It looks like an aquatic plant and serves as a ferry to Pokémon that can’t swim.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Lotad live in ponds and lakes, where they float on the surface. It grows weak if its broad leaf dies. On rare occasions, this Pokémon travels on land in search of clean water.
flavorText.sword-shield: It searches about for clean water. If it does not drink water for too long, the leaf on its head wilts.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: LOMBRE is nocturnal - it will get active after dusk. It is also a mischief-maker. When this POKéMON spots anglers, it tugs on their fishing lines from beneath the surface and enjoys their consternation.
flavorText.emerald: In the evening, it takes great delight in popping out of rivers and startling people. It feeds on aquatic moss that grows on rocks in the riverbed.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It lives at the water’s edge where it is sunny. It sleeps on a bed of water grass by day and becomes active at night.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It has a mischievous spirit. If it spots an angler, it will tug on the fishing line to interfere.
flavorText.platinum: It has a mischievous spirit. If it spots an angler, it will tug on the fishing line to interfere.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It is nocturnal and becomes active at nightfall. It feeds on aquatic mosses that grow in the riverbed.
flavorText.black-white: It has a mischievous spirit. If it spots an angler, it will tug on the fishing line to interfere.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It has a mischievous spirit. If it spots an angler, it will tug on the fishing line to interfere.
flavorText.x-y: It lives at the water’s edge where it is sunny. It sleeps on a bed of water-grass by day and becomes active at night.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Lombre is nocturnal—it will get active after dusk. It is also a mischief maker. When this Pokémon spots anglers, it tugs on their fishing lines from beneath the surface and enjoys their consternation.
flavorText.sword-shield: It is nocturnal and becomes active at nightfall. It feeds on aquatic mosses that grow in the riverbed.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: LUDICOLO begins dancing as soon as it hears cheerful, festive music. This POKéMON is said to appear when it hears the singing of children on hiking outings.
flavorText.emerald: When it hears festive music, all the cells in its body become stimulated, and it begins moving in rhythm. It does not quail even when it faces a tough opponent.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: The rhythm of bright, festive music activates LUDICOLO’s cells, making it more powerful.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: If it hears festive music, all its muscles fill with energy. It can’t help breaking out into a dance.
flavorText.platinum: If it hears festive music, all its muscles fill with energy. It can’t help breaking out into a dance.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: If it hears festive music, it begins moving in rhythm in order to amplify its power.
flavorText.black-white: If it hears festive music, all its muscles fill with energy. It can’t help breaking out into a dance.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: If it hears festive music, all its muscles fill with energy. It can’t help breaking out into a dance.
flavorText.x-y: If it hears festive music, all its muscles fill with energy. It can’t help breaking out into a dance.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Ludicolo begins dancing as soon as it hears cheerful, festive music. This Pokémon is said to appear when it hears the singing of children on hiking outings.
flavorText.sword-shield: The rhythm of bright, festive music activates Ludicolo’s cells, making it more powerful.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: SEEDOT attaches itself to a tree branch using the top of its head. It sucks moisture from the tree while hanging off the branch. The more water it drinks, the glossier this POKéMON’s body becomes.
flavorText.emerald: It hangs off branches and absorbs nutrients. When it finishes eating, its body becomes so heavy that it drops to the ground with a thump.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: If it remains still, it becomes impossible to distinguish from real nuts. It delights in surprising foraging PIDGEY.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: When it dangles from a tree branch, it looks just like an acorn. It enjoys scaring other Pokémon.
flavorText.platinum: When it dangles from a tree branch, it looks just like an acorn. It enjoys scaring other Pokémon.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It attaches itself to a tree branch using the top of its head. Strong winds can sometimes make it fall.
flavorText.black-white: When it dangles from a tree branch, it looks just like an acorn. It enjoys scaring other Pokémon.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: When it dangles from a tree branch, it looks just like an acorn. It enjoys scaring other Pokémon.
flavorText.x-y: It attaches itself to a tree branch using the top of its head. Strong winds can sometimes make it fall.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Seedot attaches itself to a tree branch using the top of its head. It sucks moisture from the tree while hanging off the branch. The more water it drinks, the glossier this Pokémon’s body becomes.
flavorText.sword-shield: If it remains still, it looks just like a real nut. It delights in surprising foraging Pokémon.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: NUZLEAF live in densely overgrown forests. They occasionally venture out of the forest to startle people. This POKéMON dislikes having its long nose pinched.
flavorText.emerald: A forest-dwelling POKéMON that is skilled at climbing trees. Its long and pointed nose is its weak point. It loses power if the nose is gripped.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: They live in holes bored in large trees. The sound of NUZLEAF’s grass flute fills listeners with dread.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: The sound of its grass flute makes its listeners uneasy. It lives deep in forests.
flavorText.platinum: The sound of its grass flute makes its listeners uneasy. It lives deep in forests.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It lives deep in forests. With the leaf on its head, it makes a flute whose song makes listeners uneasy.
flavorText.black-white: The sound of its grass flute makes its listeners uneasy. It lives deep in forests.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: The sound of its grass flute makes its listeners uneasy. It lives deep in forests.
flavorText.x-y: The sound of its grass flute makes its listeners uneasy. It lives deep in forests.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Nuzleaf live in densely overgrown forests. They occasionally venture out of the forest to startle people. This Pokémon dislikes having its long nose pinched.
flavorText.sword-shield: It lives deep in forests. With the leaf on its head, it makes a flute whose song makes listeners uneasy.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: SHIFTRY is a mysterious POKéMON that is said to live atop towering trees dating back over a thousand years. It creates terrific windstorms with the fans it holds.
flavorText.emerald: It is said to arrive on chilly, wintry winds. Feared from long ago as the guardian of forests, this POKéMON lives in a deep forest where people do not venture.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: A POKéMON that was feared as a forest guardian. It can read the foe’s mind and take preemptive action.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: By flapping its leafy fan, it can whip up gusts of 100 ft/second that can level houses.
flavorText.platinum: By flapping its leafy fan, it can whip up gusts of 100 ft/second that can level houses.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It lives quietly in the deep forest. It is said to create chilly winter winds with the fans it holds.
flavorText.black-white: By flapping its leafy fan, it can whip up gusts of 100 ft/second that can level houses.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: By flapping its leafy fan, it can whip up gusts of 100 ft/second that can level houses.
flavorText.x-y: A Pokémon that was feared as a forest guardian. It can read the foe’s mind and take preemptive action.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Shiftry is a mysterious Pokémon that is said to live atop towering trees dating back over a thousand years. It creates terrific windstorms with the fans it holds.
flavorText.sword-shield: A Pokémon that was feared as a forest guardian. It can read the foe’s mind and take preemptive action.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: TAILLOW courageously stands its ground against foes, however strong they may be. This gutsy POKéMON will remain defiant even after a loss. On the other hand, it cries loudly if it becomes hungry.
flavorText.emerald: Although it is small, it is very courageous. It will take on a larger SKARMORY on an equal footing. However, its will weakens if it becomes hungry.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It dislikes cold seasons. They migrate to other lands in search of warmth, flying over 180 miles a day.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It has a gutsy spirit that makes it bravely take on tough foes. It flies in search of warm climates.
flavorText.platinum: It has a gutsy spirit that makes it bravely take on tough foes. It flies in search of warm climates.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: When it gets cold, they migrate, flying over 180 miles a day. It hunts for tasty prey.
flavorText.black-white: It has a gutsy spirit that makes it bravely take on tough foes. It flies in search of warm climates.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It has a gutsy spirit that makes it bravely take on tough foes. It flies in search of warm climates.
flavorText.x-y: It has a gutsy spirit that makes it bravely take on tough foes. It flies in search of warm climates.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Taillow courageously stands its ground against foes, however strong they may be. This gutsy Pokémon will remain defiant even after a loss. On the other hand, it cries loudly if it becomes hungry.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: SWELLOW flies high above our heads, making graceful arcs in the sky. This POKéMON dives at a steep angle as soon as it spots its prey. The hapless prey is tightly grasped by SWELLOW’s clawed feet, preventing escape.
flavorText.emerald: A SWELLOW dives upon prey from far above. It never misses its targets. It takes to the skies in search of lands with a warm climate.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: If its two tail feathers are standing at attention, it is proof of good health. It soars elegantly in the sky.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It circles the sky in search of prey. When it spots one, it dives steeply to catch the prey.
flavorText.platinum: It circles the sky in search of prey. When it spots one, it dives steeply to catch the prey.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It dives at a steep angle as soon as it spots its prey. It catches its prey with sharp claws.
flavorText.black-white: It circles the sky in search of prey. When it spots one, it dives steeply to catch the prey.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It circles the sky in search of prey. When it spots one, it dives steeply to catch the prey.
flavorText.x-y: If its two tail feathers are standing at attention, it is proof of good health. It soars elegantly in the sky.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Swellow flies high above our heads, making graceful arcs in the sky. This Pokémon dives at a steep angle as soon as it spots its prey. The hapless prey is tightly grasped by Swellow’s clawed feet, preventing escape.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: WINGULL has the habit of carrying prey and valuables in its beak and hiding them in all sorts of locations. This POKéMON rides the winds and flies as if it were skating across the sky.
flavorText.emerald: It makes its nest on a sheer cliff at the edge of the sea. It has trouble keeping its wings flapping in flight. Instead, it soars on updrafts.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It rides upon ocean winds as if it were a glider. In the winter, it hides food around its nest.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It makes its nest on steep sea cliffs. Riding updrafts, it soars to great heights.
flavorText.platinum: It soars high in the sky, riding on updrafts like a glider. It carries food tucked in its bill.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It soars on updrafts without flapping its wings. It makes a nest on sheer cliffs at the sea’s edge.
flavorText.black-white: It soars high in the sky, riding on updrafts like a glider. It carries food tucked in its bill.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It makes its nest on sheer cliffs. Riding the sea breeze, it glides up into the expansive skies.
flavorText.x-y: Catching sea winds with its long wings, it soars as if it were a glider. It folds its wings to rest.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Wingull has the habit of carrying prey and valuables in its beak and hiding them in all sorts of locations. This Pokémon rides the winds and flies as if it were skating across the sky.
flavorText.sun-moon: Its hollow bones enhance its lightness. It spreads its wings to the wind and soars away into the sky.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: With its long, thin wings, it catches updrafts and flies like a glider high up into the sky.
flavorText.sword-shield: It makes its nest on sheer cliffs. Riding the sea breeze, it glides up into the expansive skies.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: PELIPPER is a flying transporter that carries small POKéMON and eggs inside its massive bill. This POKéMON builds its nest on steep cliffs facing the sea.
flavorText.emerald: It skims the tops of waves as it flies. When it spots prey, it uses its large beak to scoop up the victim with water. It protects its eggs in its beak.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It is a flying transporter that carries small POKéMON in its beak. It bobs on the waves to rest its wings.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It dips its large bill in the sea, then scoops up numerous prey along with water.
flavorText.platinum: It is a messenger of the skies, carrying small Pokémon and eggs to safety in its bill.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It protects its young in its beak. It bobs on waves, resting on them on days when the waters are calm.
flavorText.black-white: It is a messenger of the skies, carrying small Pokémon and eggs to safety in its bill.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Skimming the water’s surface, it dips its large bill in the sea, scoops up food and water, and carries it.
flavorText.x-y: It dips its large bill in the sea, then scoops up numerous prey along with water.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Pelipper is a flying transporter that carries small Pokémon and eggs inside its massive bill. This Pokémon builds its nest on steep cliffs facing the sea.
flavorText.sun-moon: Its spacious beak is large enough for a small child to fit right inside.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: It places small Pokémon into its spacious beak and carries them around. No one knows where it’s taking them.
flavorText.sword-shield: It is a messenger of the skies, carrying small Pokémon and eggs to safety in its bill.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: RALTS senses the emotions of people using the horns on its head. This POKéMON rarely appears before people. But when it does, it draws closer if it senses that the person has a positive disposition.
flavorText.emerald: A RALTS has the power to sense the emotions of people and POKéMON with the horns on its head. It takes cover if it senses any hostility.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It is highly attuned to the emotions of people and POKéMON. It hides if it senses hostility.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It uses the horns on its head to sense human emotions. It is said to appear in front of cheerful people.
flavorText.platinum: If its horns capture the warm feelings of people or Pokémon, its body warms up slightly.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: The horns on its head provide a strong power that enables it to sense people’s emotions.
flavorText.black-white: If its horns capture the warm feelings of people or Pokémon, its body warms up slightly.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: If its horns capture the warm feelings of people or Pokémon, its body warms up slightly.
flavorText.x-y: If its horns capture the warm feelings of people or Pokémon, its body warms up slightly.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Ralts senses the emotions of people using the horns on its head. This Pokémon rarely appears before people. But when it does, it draws closer if it senses that the person has a positive disposition.
flavorText.sword-shield: It is highly attuned to the emotions of people and Pokémon. It hides if it senses hostility.
flavorText.legends-arceus: Tends to prefer people with a chipper disposition to those who are gloomy, but it has shown no discrimination with regard to age or gender. Needs more research.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: It is said that a KIRLIA that is exposed to the positive emotions of its TRAINER grows beautiful. This POKéMON controls psychokinetic powers with its highly developed brain.
flavorText.emerald: A KIRLIA has the psychic power to create a rip in the dimensions and see into the future. It is said to dance with pleasure on sunny mornings.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: The cheerful spirit of its TRAINER gives it energy for its psychokinetic power. It spins and dances when happy.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It is highly perceptive of its Trainer’s feelings. It dances when it is feeling happy.
flavorText.platinum: If its Trainer becomes happy, it overflows with energy, dancing joyously while spinning about.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It has a psychic power that enables it to distort the space around it and see into the future.
flavorText.black-white: If its Trainer becomes happy, it overflows with energy, dancing joyously while spinning about.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: If its Trainer becomes happy, it overflows with energy, dancing joyously while spinning about.
flavorText.x-y: The cheerful spirit of its Trainer gives it energy for its psychokinetic power. It spins and dances when happy.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: It is said that a Kirlia that is exposed to the positive emotions of its Trainer grows beautiful. This Pokémon controls psychokinetic powers with its highly developed brain.
flavorText.sword-shield: If its Trainer becomes happy, it overflows with energy, dancing joyously while spinning about.
flavorText.legends-arceus: It resembles a maiden in appearance, but it wields strange powers to project visions of paradise. I suspect the crimson ornaments on its head are the key to its abilities.

flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It unleashes psychokinetic energy at full power when protecting a Trainer it has bonded closely with.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: GARDEVOIR has the ability to read the future. If it senses impending danger to its TRAINER, this POKéMON is said to unleash its psychokinetic energy at full power.
flavorText.emerald: It apparently does not feel the pull of gravity because it supports itself with psychic power. It will give its life to protect its TRAINER.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It has the power to predict the future. Its power peaks when it is protecting its TRAINER.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It will try to guard its trusted Trainer with its life. It has the ability to see the future.
flavorText.platinum: To protect its Trainer, it will expend all its psychic power to create a small black hole.
flavorText.black-white: To protect its Trainer, it will expend all its psychic power to create a small black hole.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: To protect its Trainer, it will expend all its psychic power to create a small black hole.
flavorText.x-y: To protect its Trainer, it will expend all its psychic power to create a small black hole.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Gardevoir has the ability to read the future. If it senses impending danger to its Trainer, this Pokémon is said to unleash its psychokinetic energy at full power.
flavorText.sword-shield: It has the power to predict the future. Its power peaks when it is protecting its Trainer.
flavorText.legends-arceus: It will dedicate itself to defending a master it has come to adore. Its pure white dress, reminiscent of those worn by ladies of nobility, is the dress of one who is willing to risk their life.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: From the tips of its feet, SURSKIT secretes an oil that enables it to walk on water as if it were skating. This POKéMON feeds on microscopic organisms in ponds and lakes.
flavorText.emerald: They gather on puddles after evening downpours, gliding across the surface of water as if sliding. It secretes honey with a sweet aroma from its head.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: They usually live on ponds, but after an evening shower, they may appear on puddles in towns.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It appears as if it is skating on water. It draws prey with a sweet scent from the tip of its head.
flavorText.platinum: It appears as if it is skating on water. It draws prey with a sweet scent from the tip of its head.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It secretes a thick, sweet-scented syrup from the tip of its head. It lives on weed-choked ponds.
flavorText.black-white: It appears as if it is skating on water. It draws prey with a sweet scent from the tip of its head.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It appears as if it is skating on water. It draws prey with a sweet scent from the tip of its head.
flavorText.x-y: They usually live on ponds, but after an evening shower, they may appear on puddles in towns.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: From the tips of its feet, Surskit secretes an oil that enables it to walk on water as if it were skating. This Pokémon feeds on microscopic organisms in ponds and lakes.
flavorText.sun-moon: It moves as if skating on the surface of the water. It often fights with Dewpider over food.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: If it’s in a pinch, it will secrete a sweet liquid from the tip of its head. Syrup made from gathering that liquid is tasty on bread.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: MASQUERAIN intimidates enemies with the eyelike patterns on its antennas. This POKéMON flaps its four wings to freely fly in any direction - even sideways and backwards - as if it were a helicopter.
flavorText.emerald: It intimidates foes with the large eyelike patterns on its antennae. Because it can’t fly if its wings get wet, it shelters itself from rain under large trees and eaves.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: The antennae have distinctive patterns that look like eyes. When it rains, they grow heavy, making flight impossible.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: Its antennae have eye patterns on them. Its four wings enable it to hover and fly in any direction.
flavorText.platinum: Its antennae have eye patterns on them. Its four wings enable it to hover and fly in any direction.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It flaps its four wings to hover and fly freely in any direction-- to and fro and sideways.
flavorText.black-white: Its antennae have eye patterns on them. Its four wings enable it to hover and fly in any direction.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Its antennae have eye patterns on them. Its four wings enable it to hover and fly in any direction.
flavorText.x-y: Its antennae have eye patterns on them. Its four wings enable it to hover and fly in any direction.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Masquerain intimidates enemies with the eyelike patterns on its antennas. This Pokémon flaps its four wings to freely fly in any direction—even sideways and backwards—as if it were a helicopter.
flavorText.sun-moon: It intimidates enemies with the eye-like patterns on its antennae. Its four wings allow it to fly in any direction.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: Masquerain intimidates enemies with the eyelike patterns of its eyespots. If that doesn’t work, it deftly makes its escape on its set of four wings.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: SHROOMISH live in damp soil in the dark depths of forests. They are often found keeping still under fallen leaves. This POKéMON feeds on compost that is made up of fallen, rotted leaves.
flavorText.emerald: It loves to eat damp, composted soil in forests. If you enter a forest after a long rain, you can see many SHROOMISH feasting on composted soil.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It prefers damp places. By day it remains still in the forest shade. It releases toxic powder from its head.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It spouts poison spores from the top of its head. These spores cause pain all over if inhaled.
flavorText.platinum: It spouts poison spores from the top of its head. These spores cause pain all over if inhaled.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: If it senses danger, it scatters spores from the top of its head to protect itself.
flavorText.black-white: It spouts poison spores from the top of its head. These spores cause pain all over if inhaled.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It spouts poison spores from the top of its head. These spores cause pain all over if inhaled.
flavorText.x-y: It prefers damp places. By day it remains still in the forest shade. It releases toxic powder from its head.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Shroomish live in damp soil in the dark depths of forests. They are often found keeping still under fallen leaves. This Pokémon feeds on compost that is made up of fallen, rotted leaves.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: BRELOOM closes in on its foe with light and sprightly footwork, then throws punches with its stretchy arms. This POKéMON’s fighting technique puts boxers to shame.
flavorText.emerald: It scatters spores from holes in the cap on its head. It loves warm and humid climates. It feeds on trees and plants in fields and forests.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: The seeds on its tail are made of toxic spores. It knocks out foes with quick, virtually invisible punches.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: Its short arms stretch when it throws punches. Its technique is equal to that of pro boxers.
flavorText.platinum: Its short arms stretch when it throws punches. Its technique is equal to that of pro boxers.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It scatters poisonous spores and throws powerful punches while its foe is hampered by inhaled spores.
flavorText.black-white: Its short arms stretch when it throws punches. Its technique is equal to that of pro boxers.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Its short arms stretch when it throws punches. Its technique is equal to that of pro boxers.
flavorText.x-y: Its short arms stretch when it throws punches. Its technique is equal to that of pro boxers.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Breloom closes in on its foe with light and sprightly footwork, then throws punches with its stretchy arms. This Pokémon’s fighting technique puts boxers to shame.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: SLAKOTH lolls around for over twenty hours every day. Because it moves so little, it does not need much food. This POKéMON’s sole daily meal consists of just three leaves.
flavorText.emerald: It sleeps virtually all day and night long. It doesn’t change its nest its entire life, but it sometimes travels great distances by swimming in rivers.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It sleeps for 20 hours every day. Making drowsy those that see it is one of its abilities.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It spends nearly all its time in a day sprawled out. Just seeing it makes one drowsy.
flavorText.platinum: It spends nearly all its time in a day sprawled out. Just seeing it makes one drowsy.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: The way SLAKOTH lolls around makes anyone who watches it feel like doing the same.
flavorText.black-white: It spends nearly all its time in a day sprawled out. Just seeing it makes one drowsy.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: If it eats just three leaves in a day, it is satisfied. Other than that, it sleeps for 20 hours a day.
flavorText.x-y: The way Slakoth lolls around makes anyone who watches it feel like doing the same.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Slakoth lolls around for over 20 hours every day. Because it moves so little, it does not need much food. This Pokémon’s sole daily meal consists of just three leaves.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: VIGOROTH is always itching and agitated to go on a wild rampage. It simply can’t tolerate sitting still for even a minute. This POKéMON’s stress level rises if it can’t be moving constantly.
flavorText.emerald: It can’t keep still because its blood boils with energy. It runs through the fields and mountains all day to calm itself. If it doesn’t, it can’t sleep at night.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It is always hungry because it won’t stop rampaging. Even while it is eating, it can’t keep still.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: Its heart beats at a tenfold tempo, so it cannot sit still for even a moment.
flavorText.platinum: Its heart beats at a tenfold tempo, so it cannot sit still for even a moment.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: Its stress level rises if it cannot keep moving constantly. Too much stress makes it feel sick.
flavorText.black-white: Its heart beats at a tenfold tempo, so it cannot sit still for even a moment.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Its heartbeat is fast and its blood so agitated that it can’t sit still for one second.
flavorText.x-y: Its heartbeat is fast and its blood so agitated that it can’t sit still for one second.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Vigoroth is always itching and agitated to go on a wild rampage. It simply can’t tolerate sitting still for even a minute. This Pokémon’s stress level rises if it can’t be moving constantly.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: SLAKING spends all day lying down and lolling about. It eats grass growing within its reach. If it eats all the grass it can reach, this POKéMON reluctantly moves to another spot.
flavorText.emerald: Hordes of SLAKING gather around trees when fruits come into season. They wait around patiently for ripened fruits to fall out of the trees.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It is the world’s most slothful POKéMON. However, it can exert horrifying power by releasing pent-up energy all at once.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: The world’s laziest Pokémon. When it is lounging, it is actually saving energy for striking back.
flavorText.platinum: The world’s laziest Pokémon. When it is lounging, it is actually saving energy for striking back.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: The world’s laziest Pokémon. It moves to another spot when there’s no food left within its reach.
flavorText.black-white: The world’s laziest Pokémon. When it is lounging, it is actually saving energy for striking back.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: This Pokémon lives lying on its side. It only rolls over and moves when there is no more grass to eat.
flavorText.x-y: The world’s laziest Pokémon. It moves to another spot when there’s no food left within its reach.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Slaking spends all day lying down and lolling about. It eats grass growing within its reach. If it eats all the grass it can reach, this Pokémon reluctantly moves to another spot.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: NINCADA lives underground for many years in complete darkness. This POKéMON absorbs nutrients from the roots of trees. It stays motionless as it waits for evolution.
flavorText.emerald: It makes its nest at the roots of a mighty tree. Using its whiskerlike antennae, it probes its surroundings in the pitch-black darkness of soil.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: Because it lived almost entirely underground, it is nearly blind. It uses its antennae instead.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It grows underground, sensing its surroundings using antennae instead of its virtually blind eyes.
flavorText.platinum: It grows underground, sensing its surroundings using antennae instead of its virtually blind eyes.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It can sometimes live underground for more than 10 years. It absorbs nutrients from the roots of trees.
flavorText.black-white: It grows underground, sensing its surroundings using antennae instead of its virtually blind eyes.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It grows underground, sensing its surroundings using antennae instead of its virtually blind eyes.
flavorText.sword-shield: Because it lived almost entirely underground, it is nearly blind. It uses its antennae instead.
flavorText.x-y: Because it lived almost entirely underground, it is nearly blind. It uses its antennae instead.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Nincada lives underground for many years in complete darkness. This Pokémon absorbs nutrients from the roots of trees. It stays motionless as it waits for evolution.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: NINJASK moves around at such a high speed that it cannot be seen, even while its crying can be clearly heard. For that reason, this POKéMON was long believed to be invisible.
flavorText.emerald: Because it darts about vigorously at high speed, it is very difficult to see. Hearing its distinctive cries for too long induces a headache.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: This POKéMON is so quick, it is said to be able to avoid any attack. It loves to feed on tree sap.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: Because it moves so quickly, it sometimes becomes unseeable. It congregates around tree sap.
flavorText.platinum: Because it moves so quickly, it sometimes becomes unseeable. It congregates around tree sap.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: Its cry leaves a lasting headache if heard for too long. It moves so quickly that it is almost invisible.
flavorText.black-white: Because it moves so quickly, it sometimes becomes unseeable. It congregates around tree sap.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Because it moves so quickly, it sometimes becomes unseeable. It congregates around tree sap.
flavorText.x-y: Its cry leaves a lasting headache if heard for too long. It moves so quickly that it is almost invisible.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Ninjask moves around at such a high speed that it cannot be seen, even while its crying can be clearly heard. For that reason, this Pokémon was long believed to be invisible.
flavorText.sword-shield: Its cry leaves a lasting headache if heard for too long. It moves so quickly that it is almost invisible.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: SHEDINJA’s hard body doesn’t move - not even a twitch. In fact, its body appears to be merely a hollow shell. It is believed that this POKéMON will steal the spirit of anyone peering into its hollow body from its back.
flavorText.emerald: A peculiar POKéMON that floats in air even though its wings remain completely still. The inside of its body is hollow and utterly dark.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: A most peculiar POKéMON that somehow appears in a POKé BALL when a NINCADA evolves.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: A discarded bug shell that came to life. Peering into the crack on its back is said to steal one’s spirit.
flavorText.platinum: A discarded bug shell that came to life. Peering into the crack on its back is said to steal one’s spirit.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: A strange Pokémon--it flies without moving its wings, has a hollow shell for a body, and does not breathe.
flavorText.black-white: A discarded bug shell that came to life. Peering into the crack on its back is said to steal one’s spirit.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: A discarded bug shell that came to life. Peering into the crack on its back is said to steal one’s spirit.
flavorText.x-y: A discarded bug shell that came to life. Peering into the crack on its back is said to steal one’s spirit.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Shedinja’s hard body doesn’t move—not even a twitch. In fact, its body appears to be merely a hollow shell. It is believed that this Pokémon will steal the spirit of anyone peering into its hollow body from its back.
flavorText.sword-shield: A most peculiar Pokémon that somehow appears in a Poké Ball when a Nincada evolves.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: Normally, WHISMUR’s voice is very quiet - it is barely audible even if one is paying close attention. However, if this POKéMON senses danger, it starts crying at an earsplitting volume.
flavorText.emerald: Its cries equal a jet plane in volume. It inhales through its ear canals. Because of this system, it can cry continually without having to catch its breath.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It usually murmurs, but starts crying loudly if it senses danger. It stops when its ear covers are shut.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: Usually, its cries are like quiet murmurs. If frightened, it shrieks at the same volume as a jet plane.
flavorText.platinum: Usually, its cries are like quiet murmurs. If frightened, it shrieks at the same volume as a jet plane.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: If it senses danger, it scares the foe by crying out with the volume of a jet-plane engine.
flavorText.black-white: Usually, its cries are like quiet murmurs. If frightened, it shrieks at the same volume as a jet plane.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Usually, its cries are like quiet murmurs. If frightened, it shrieks at the same volume as a jet plane.
flavorText.x-y: It usually murmurs but starts crying loudly if it senses danger. It stops when its ear covers are shut.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Normally, Whismur’s voice is very quiet—it is barely audible even if one is paying close attention. However, if this Pokémon senses danger, it starts crying at an earsplitting volume.
flavorText.sword-shield: The cry of a Whismur is over 100 decibels. If you’re close to a Whismur when it lets out a cry, you’ll be stuck with an all-day headache.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: LOUDRED’s bellowing can completely decimate a wood-frame house. It uses its voice to punish its foes. This POKéMON’s round ears serve as loudspeakers.
flavorText.emerald: It positions the round speakers on its head to assail foes with ultrasonic waves at massive volume. It builds power by stomping the ground.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: When it stamps its feet and bellows, it generates ultrasonic waves that can blow apart a house.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: The shock waves from its cries can tip over trucks. It stamps its feet to power up.
flavorText.platinum: The shock waves from its cries can tip over trucks. It stamps its feet to power up.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It shouts loudly by inhaling air, and then uses its well-developed stomach muscles to exhale.
flavorText.black-white: The shock waves from its cries can tip over trucks. It stamps its feet to power up.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: The shock waves from its cries can tip over trucks. It stamps its feet to power up.
flavorText.x-y: It shouts loudly by inhaling air, and then uses its well-developed stomach muscles to exhale.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Loudred’s bellowing can completely decimate a wood-frame house. It uses its voice to punish its foes. This Pokémon’s round ears serve as loudspeakers.
flavorText.sword-shield: Loudred’s ears serve as speakers, and they can put out sound waves powerful enough to blow away a house.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: EXPLOUD triggers earthquakes with the tremors it creates by bellowing. If this POKéMON violently inhales from the ports on its body, it’s a sign that it is preparing to let loose a huge bellow.
flavorText.emerald: It has sound-generating organs all over its body. It communicates with others by adjusting the tone and volume of the cries it emits.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It emits a variety of sounds from the holes all over its body. Its loud cries can be heard from over six miles away.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: Its howls can be heard over six miles away. It emits all sorts of noises from the ports on its body.
flavorText.platinum: Its howls can be heard over six miles away. It emits all sorts of noises from the ports on its body.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: Its roar in battle shakes the ground like a tremor--or like an earthquake has struck.
flavorText.black-white: Its howls can be heard over six miles away. It emits all sorts of noises from the ports on its body.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Its howls can be heard over six miles away. It emits all sorts of noises from the ports on its body.
flavorText.x-y: Its howls can be heard over six miles away. It emits all sorts of noises from the ports on its body.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Exploud triggers earthquakes with the tremors it creates by bellowing. If this Pokémon violently inhales from the ports on its body, it’s a sign that it is preparing to let loose a huge bellow.
flavorText.sword-shield: In the past, people would use the loud voices of these Pokémon as a means of communication between distant cities.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: MAKUHITA is tenacious - it will keep getting up and attacking its foe however many times it is knocked down. Every time it gets back up, this POKéMON stores more energy in its body for evolving.
flavorText.emerald: It loves to toughen up its body above all else. If you hear quaking rumbles in a cave, it is the sound of MAKUHITA undertaking strenuous training.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It grows stronger by enduring harsh training. It is a gutsy POKéMON that can withstand any attack.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It toughens its body by slamming into thick trees. Many snapped trees can be found near its nest.
flavorText.platinum: It toughens its body by slamming into thick trees. Many snapped trees can be found near its nest.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It toughens up by slamming into thick trees over and over. It gains a sturdy body and dauntless spirit.
flavorText.black-white: It toughens its body by slamming into thick trees. Many snapped trees can be found near its nest.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It toughens its body by slamming into thick trees. Many snapped trees can be found near its nest.
flavorText.x-y: It toughens up by slamming into thick trees over and over. It gains a sturdy body and dauntless spirit.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Makuhita is tenacious—it will keep getting up and attacking its foe however many times it is knocked down. Every time it gets back up, this Pokémon stores more energy in its body for evolving.
flavorText.sun-moon: It was originally brought in from another region, but now Makuhita from Alola are more famous.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: It practices its slaps by repeatedly slapping tree trunks. It has been known to slap an Exeggutor and get flung away.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: HARIYAMA practices its straight-arm slaps in any number of locations. One hit of this POKéMON’s powerful, openhanded, straight-arm punches could snap a telephone pole in two.
flavorText.emerald: It has the habit of challenging others without hesitation to tests of strength. It’s been known to stand on train tracks and stop trains using forearm thrusts.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It stomps on the ground to build power. It can send a 10-ton truck flying with a straight-arm punch.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It loves to match power with big-bodied Pokémon. It can knock a truck flying with its arm thrusts.
flavorText.platinum: It loves to match power with big-bodied Pokémon. It can knock a truck flying with its arm thrusts.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It loves challenging others to tests of strength. It has the power to stop a train with a slap.
flavorText.black-white: It loves to match power with big-bodied Pokémon. It can knock a truck flying with its arm thrusts.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It loves to match power with big-bodied Pokémon. It can knock a truck flying with its arm thrusts.
flavorText.x-y: It stomps on the ground to build power. It can send a 10-ton truck flying with a straight-arm punch.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Hariyama practices its straight-arm slaps in any number of locations. One hit of this Pokémon’s powerful, openhanded, straight-arm punches could snap a telephone pole in two.
flavorText.sun-moon: It is known for its fantastic strength, but as it grows older, it focuses more on training Makuhita.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: Although they enjoy comparing their strength, they’re also kind. They value etiquette, praising opponents they battle.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: AZURILL spins its tail as if it were a lasso, then hurls it far. The momentum of the throw sends its body flying, too. Using this unique action, one of these POKéMON managed to hurl itself a record 33 feet.
flavorText.emerald: Its tail, which is packed with nutrition, is very bouncy like a rubber ball. On sunny days they gather at the edge of water and splash about for fun.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It battles by flinging around its tail, which is bigger than its body. The tail is a flotation device in water.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: A Pokémon that lives by water. It moves quickly on land by bouncing on its big tail.
flavorText.platinum: Its tail bounces like a rubber ball. It flings that tail around to fight opponents bigger than itself.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: Its tail is packed full of the nutrients it needs to grow.
flavorText.black-white: Its tail bounces like a rubber ball. It flings that tail around to fight opponents bigger than itself.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It swings its large, nutrient-filled tail around to fight opponents bigger than itself.
flavorText.x-y: A Pokémon that lives by water. It moves quickly on land by bouncing on its big tail.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Azurill spins its tail as if it were a lasso, then hurls it far. The momentum of the throw sends its body flying, too. Using this unique action, one of these Pokémon managed to hurl itself a record 33 feet.
flavorText.sword-shield: The ball on Azurill’s tail bounces like a rubber ball, and it’s full of the nutrients the Pokémon needs to grow.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: NOSEPASS’s magnetic nose is always pointed to the north. If two of these POKéMON meet, they cannot turn their faces to each other when they are close because their magnetic noses repel one another.
flavorText.emerald: Its body emits a powerful magnetism. It feeds on prey that is pulled in by the force. Its magnetism is stronger in cold seasons.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: Its magnetic nose consistently faces north. Travelers check NOSEPASS to get their bearings.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: Its nose is a magnet. As a result, this Pokémon always keeps its face pointing north.
flavorText.platinum: When endangered, it may protect itself by raising its magnetism and drawing iron objects to its body.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: If two of these meet, they cannot get too close because their noses repel each other.
flavorText.black-white: When endangered, it may protect itself by raising its magnetism and drawing iron objects to its body.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Its magnetic nose always faces north and draws iron objects to its body to protect itself better.
flavorText.x-y: Its magnetic nose always faces north and draws iron objects to its body to protect itself better.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Nosepass’s magnetic nose is always pointed to the north. If two of these Pokémon meet, they cannot turn their faces to each other when they are close because their magnetic noses repel one another.
flavorText.sun-moon: The magnet in Nosepass’s nose provides an unerring compass, making it an excellent partner for Trainers going on a journey.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: It moves less than an inch a year, but when it’s in a jam, it will spin and drill down into the ground in a split second.
flavorText.legends-arceus: Once the people of Hisui discovered that its red nose always points north, they grew to rely on it greatly when traveling afar. The nose seems to work in a similar way to ancient compasses.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: SKITTY has the habit of becoming fascinated by moving objects and chasing them around. This POKéMON is known to chase after its own tail and become dizzy.
flavorText.emerald: A SKITTY’s adorably cute behavior makes it highly popular. In battle, it makes its tail puff out. It threatens foes with a sharp growl.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It is said to be difficult to earn its trust. However, it is extremely popular for its cute looks and behavior.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It can’t stop itself from chasing moving things, and it runs in a circle, chasing its own tail.
flavorText.platinum: It can’t stop itself from chasing moving things, and it runs in a circle, chasing its own tail.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It’s adorable when it chases its own tail. It’s difficult to earn its trust.
flavorText.black-white: It can’t stop itself from chasing moving things, and it runs in a circle, chasing its own tail.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It shows its cute side by chasing its own tail until it gets dizzy.
flavorText.x-y: It can’t stop itself from chasing moving things, and it runs in a circle, chasing its own tail.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Skitty has the habit of becoming fascinated by moving objects and chasing them around. This Pokémon is known to chase after its own tail and become dizzy.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: DELCATTY prefers to live an unfettered existence in which it can do as it pleases at its own pace. Because this POKéMON eats and sleeps whenever it decides, its daily routines are completely random.
flavorText.emerald: Rather than keeping a permanent lair, it habitually seeks comfortable spots and sleeps there. It is nocturnal and becomes active at dusk.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: The favorite of trend-conscious female TRAINERS, they are used in competition for their style and fur.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It is highly popular among female Trainers for its sublime fur. It does not keep a nest.
flavorText.platinum: It is highly popular among female Trainers for its sublime fur. It does not keep a nest.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It dislikes dirty places. It often searches for a comfortable place in which to groom itself.
flavorText.black-white: It is highly popular among female Trainers for its sublime fur. It does not keep a nest.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: The reason it does not have a nest is that it simply searches for a clean, comfortable place then sleeps there.
flavorText.x-y: It dislikes dirty places. It often searches for a comfortable place in which to groom itself.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Delcatty prefers to live an unfettered existence in which it can do as it pleases at its own pace. Because this Pokémon eats and sleeps whenever it decides, its daily routines are completely random.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: SABLEYE lead quiet lives deep inside caverns. They are feared, however, because these POKéMON are thought to steal the spirits of people when their eyes burn with a sinister glow in the darkness.
flavorText.emerald: It digs branching holes in caves using its sharp claws in search of food--raw gems. A SABLEYE lurks in darkness and is seen only rarely.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It feeds on gemstone crystals. In darkness, its eyes sparkle with the glitter of jewels.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It hides in the darkness of caves. Its diet of gems has transformed its eyes into gemstones.
flavorText.platinum: It hides in the darkness of caves. Its diet of gems has transformed its eyes into gemstones.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It dwells in the darkness of caves. It uses its sharp claws to dig up gems to nourish itself.
flavorText.black-white: It hides in the darkness of caves. Its diet of gems has transformed its eyes into gemstones.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It hides in the darkness of caves. Its diet of gems has transformed its eyes into gemstones.
flavorText.x-y: It hides in the darkness of caves. Its diet of gems has transformed its eyes into gemstones.
