flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Sableye lead quiet lives deep inside caverns. They are feared, however, because these Pokémon are thought to steal the spirits of people when their eyes burn with a sinister glow in the darkness.
flavorText.sun-moon: It’s a fiend for gemstones, so it stalks Carbink. Unfortunately, Gabite almost always grabs them first.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: It digs through the ground with its hard claws and crunches down gems with its thick pointy teeth. Carbink is its favorite food.
flavorText.sword-shield: This Pokémon is feared. When its gemstone eyes begin to glow with a sinister shine, it’s believed that Sableye will steal people’s spirits away.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: MAWHILE’s huge jaws are actually steel horns that have been transformed. Its docile-looking face serves to lull its foe into letting down its guard. When the foe least expects it, MAWHILE chomps it with its gaping jaws.
flavorText.emerald: Its giant jaws are actually steel horns that transformed. It fools foes into complacency with its adorable gestures, then chomps them with its huge jaws.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It uses its docile-looking face to lull foes into complacency, then bites with its huge, relentless jaws.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: Attached to its head is a huge set of jaws formed by horns. It can chew through iron beams.
flavorText.platinum: Attached to its head is a huge set of jaws formed by horns. It can chew through iron beams.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It chomps with its gaping mouth. Its huge jaws are actually steel horns that have been transformed.
flavorText.black-white: Attached to its head is a huge set of jaws formed by horns. It can chew through iron beams.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Attached to its head is a huge set of jaws formed by horns. It can chew through iron beams.
flavorText.x-y: It uses its docile-looking face to lull foes into complacency, then bites with its huge, relentless jaws.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Mawile’s huge jaws are actually steel horns that have been transformed. Its docile-looking face serves to lull its foe into letting down its guard. When the foe least expects it, Mawile chomps it with its gaping jaws.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: A cunning and terrifying Pokémon, its cuteness makes opponents let down their guard—and then it swallows them whole with its huge jaws.
flavorText.sword-shield: It uses its docile-looking face to lull foes into complacency, then bites with its huge, relentless jaws.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: This POKéMON has a body of steel. To make its body, ARON feeds on iron ore that it digs from mountains. Occasionally, it causes major trouble by eating bridges and rails.
flavorText.emerald: A POKéMON that is clad in steel armor. A new suit of armor is made when it evolves. The old, discarded armor is salvaged as metal for making iron products.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It eats iron to build its steel body. It is a pest that descends from mountains to eat bridges and train tracks.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It usually lives deep in mountains. However, hunger may drive it to eat railroad tracks and cars.
flavorText.platinum: It usually lives deep in mountains. However, hunger may drive it to eat railroad tracks and cars.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: When it evolves, it sheds the steel carapace that covered its whole body and develops a new one.
flavorText.black-white: It usually lives deep in mountains. However, hunger may drive it to eat railroad tracks and cars.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: In order to build up its steel body, it eats iron ore. This pesky Pokémon is known to eat railroad tracks.
flavorText.x-y: It usually lives deep in mountains. However, hunger may drive it to eat railroad tracks and cars.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: This Pokémon has a body of steel. To make its body, Aron feeds on iron ore that it digs from mountains. Occasionally, it causes major trouble by eating bridges and rails.
flavorText.sword-shield: It eats iron ore—and sometimes railroad tracks— to build up the steel armor that protects its body.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: LAIRON tempers its steel body by drinking highly nutritious mineral springwater until it is bloated. This POKéMON makes its nest close to springs of delicious water.
flavorText.emerald: When two LAIRON meet in the wild, they fight for territory by bashing into each other with their steel bodies. The sound of their collision carries for miles.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It habitually shows off its strength with the size of sparks it creates by ramming its steel body into boulders.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: For food, it digs up iron ore. It smashes its steely body against others to fight over territory.
flavorText.platinum: For food, it digs up iron ore. It smashes its steely body against others to fight over territory.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It loves iron ore. Groups of them fight for territory by bashing one another with their steel bodies.
flavorText.black-white: For food, it digs up iron ore. It smashes its steely body against others to fight over territory.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Lairon fight over territory, and when their steel bodies collide, sparks fly.
flavorText.x-y: It loves iron ore. Groups of them fight for territory by bashing one another with their steel bodies.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Lairon tempers its steel body by drinking highly nutritious mineral springwater until it is bloated. This Pokémon makes its nest close to springs of delicious water.
flavorText.sword-shield: Lairon live in mountains brimming with spring water and iron ore, so these Pokémon often came into conflict with humans in the past.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: AGGRON claims an entire mountain as its own territory. It mercilessly beats up anything that violates its environment. This POKéMON vigilantly patrols its territory at all times.
flavorText.emerald: Its iron horns grow longer a little at a time. They are used to determine the AGGRON’s age. The gouges in its armor are worn with pride as mementos from battles.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It claims a large mountain as its sole territory. It mercilessly thrashes those that violate its space.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: While seeking iron for food, it digs tunnels by breaking through bedrock with its steel horns.
flavorText.platinum: While seeking iron for food, it digs tunnels by breaking through bedrock with its steel horns.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: You can tell its age by the length of its iron horns. It claims an entire mountain as its territory.
flavorText.black-white: While seeking iron for food, it digs tunnels by breaking through bedrock with its steel horns.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It claims an entire mountain as its own. The more wounds it has, the more it has battled, so don’t take it lightly.
flavorText.x-y: It claims an entire mountain as its own. The more wounds it has, the more it has battled, so don’t take it lightly.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Aggron claims an entire mountain as its own territory. It mercilessly beats up anything that violates its environment. This Pokémon vigilantly patrols its territory at all times.
flavorText.sword-shield: Aggron has a horn sharp enough to perforate thick iron sheets. It brings down its opponents by ramming into them horn first.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: MEDITITE undertakes rigorous mental training deep in the mountains. However, whenever it meditates, this POKéMON always loses its concentration and focus. As a result, its training never ends.
flavorText.emerald: It continually meditates for hours every day. As a result of rigorous and dedicated yoga training, it has tempered its spiritual power so much it can fly.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It never skips its daily yoga training. It heightens its inner strength through meditation.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It eats just one berry a day. By enduring hunger, its spirit is tempered and made sharper.
flavorText.platinum: It always trains deep in mountains. It levitates when it heightens its spiritual power through meditation.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It meditates to heighten its inner energy and to float in the air. It eats one berry a day.
flavorText.black-white: It always trains deep in mountains. It levitates when it heightens its spiritual power through meditation.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It always trains deep in mountains. It levitates when it heightens its spiritual power through meditation.
flavorText.x-y: It always trains deep in mountains. It levitates when it heightens its spiritual power through meditation.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Meditite undertakes rigorous mental training deep in the mountains. However, whenever it meditates, this Pokémon always loses its concentration and focus. As a result, its training never ends.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: It is said that through meditation, MEDICHAM heightens energy inside its body and sharpens its sixth sense. This POKéMON hides its presence by merging itself with fields and mountains.
flavorText.emerald: Through crushingly harsh yoga training, it gained the power to foretell its foe’s actions. It battles with elegant, dance- like movement.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It elegantly avoids attacks with dance- like steps, then launches a devastating blow in the same motion.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: Through yoga training, it has honed its sixth sense. Its movements are elegant.
flavorText.platinum: It gains the ability to see the aura of its opponents by honing its mind through starvation.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: Through yoga training, it gained the psychic power to predict its foe’s next move.
flavorText.black-white: It gains the ability to see the aura of its opponents by honing its mind through starvation.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It gains the ability to see the aura of its opponents by honing its mind through starvation.
flavorText.x-y: It elegantly avoids attacks with dance-like steps, then launches a devastating blow in the same motion.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: It is said that through meditation, Medicham heightens energy inside its body and sharpens its sixth sense. This Pokémon hides its presence by merging itself with fields and mountains.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: ELECTRIKE stores electricity in its long body hair. This POKéMON stimulates its leg muscles with electric charges. These jolts of power give its legs explosive acceleration performance.
flavorText.emerald: It generates electricity using friction from the atmosphere. In seasons with especially arid air, its entire body blazes with violent showers of sparks.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It stores static electricity in its fur for discharging. It gives off sparks if a storm approaches.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: Using electricity stored in its fur, it stimulates its muscles to heighten its reaction speed.
flavorText.platinum: Using electricity stored in its fur, it stimulates its muscles to heighten its reaction speed.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It stores electricity in its fur. It gives off sparks from all over its body in seasons when the air is dry.
flavorText.black-white: Using electricity stored in its fur, it stimulates its muscles to heighten its reaction speed.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Using electricity stored in its fur, it stimulates its muscles to heighten its reaction speed.
flavorText.x-y: Using electricity stored in its fur, it stimulates its muscles to heighten its reaction speed.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Electrike stores electricity in its long body hair. This Pokémon stimulates its leg muscles with electric charges. These jolts of power give its legs explosive acceleration performance.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: Friction between the air and its fur produces static electricity. When Electrike runs, it makes a crackling sound.
flavorText.sword-shield: It stores static electricity in its fur for discharging. It gives off sparks if a storm approaches.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: MANECTRIC is constantly discharging electricity from its mane. The sparks sometimes ignite forest fires. When it enters a battle, this POKéMON creates thunderclouds.
flavorText.emerald: Because lightning falls in their vicinities, MANECTRIC were thought to have been born from lightning. In battle, they create thunderclouds.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It rarely appears before people. It is said to nest where lightning has fallen.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It discharges electricity from its mane. It creates a thundercloud overhead to drop lightning bolts.
flavorText.platinum: It discharges electricity from its mane. It creates a thundercloud overhead to drop lightning bolts.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: Its nest can be found where a thunderbolt hits. It is discharging electricity from its mane.
flavorText.black-white: It discharges electricity from its mane. It creates a thundercloud overhead to drop lightning bolts.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It discharges electricity from its mane. It creates a thundercloud overhead to drop lightning bolts.
flavorText.x-y: It rarely appears before people. It is said to nest where lightning has fallen.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Manectric is constantly discharging electricity from its mane. The sparks sometimes ignite forest fires. When it enters a battle, this Pokémon creates thunderclouds.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: Manectric can be found beneath unnatural thunderclouds. People say it can run at the same speed as lightning striking.
flavorText.sword-shield: It stimulates its own muscles with electricity, so it can move quickly. It eases its soreness with electricity, too, so it can recover quickly as well.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: PLUSLE always acts as a cheerleader for its partners. Whenever a teammate puts out a good effort in battle, this POKéMON shorts out its body to create the crackling noises of sparks to show its joy.
flavorText.emerald: It has the trait of cheering on its fellow POKéMON. By shorting out the electricity it releases from its paws, it creates pom-poms for cheering.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It cheers on partners while scattering sparks from its body. It climbs telephone poles to absorb electricity.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It cheers on friends with pom-poms made of sparks. It drains power from telephone poles.
flavorText.platinum: It cheers on friends with pom-poms made of sparks. It drains power from telephone poles.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It absorbs electricity from telephone poles. It shorts out its body to create crackling noises.
flavorText.black-white: It cheers on friends with pom-poms made of sparks. It drains power from telephone poles.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It cheers on friends with pom-poms made of sparks. It drains power from telephone poles.
flavorText.x-y: It cheers on friends with pom-poms made of sparks. It drains power from telephone poles.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Plusle always acts as a cheerleader for its partners. Whenever a teammate puts out a good effort in battle, this Pokémon shorts out its body to create the crackling noises of sparks to show its joy.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: MINUN is more concerned about cheering on its partners than its own safety. It shorts out the electricity in its body to create brilliant showers of sparks to cheer on its teammates.
flavorText.emerald: At a meeting of POKéMON academics, it was announced that simultaneous exposure to electricity from a PLUSLE and MINUN will promote circulation and boost vitality.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: Its dislike of water makes it take shelter under the eaves of houses in rain. It uses pom-poms made of sparks for cheering.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It cheers on friends. If its friends are losing, its body lets off more and more sparks.
flavorText.platinum: It cheers on friends. If its friends are losing, its body lets off more and more sparks.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: Exposure to electricity from MINUN and PLUSLE promotes blood circulation and relaxes muscles.
flavorText.black-white: It cheers on friends. If its friends are losing, its body lets off more and more sparks.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It cheers on friends. If its friends are losing, its body lets off more and more sparks.
flavorText.x-y: Exposure to electricity from Minun and Plusle promotes blood circulation and relaxes muscles.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Minun is more concerned about cheering on its partners than its own safety. It shorts out the electricity in its body to create brilliant showers of sparks to cheer on its teammates.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: With the arrival of night, VOLBEAT emits light from its tail. It communicates with others by adjusting the intensity and flashing of its light. This POKéMON is attracted by the sweet aroma of ILLUMISE.
flavorText.emerald: With their taillights lit, VOLBEAT fly in a swarm, drawing geometric designs in the night sky. They move their nests if their pond water becomes dirty.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It lives around clean ponds. At night, its rear lights up. It converses with others by flashing its light.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It communicates with others by lighting up its rear at night. It loves ILLUMISE’s sweet aroma.
flavorText.platinum: It communicates with others by lighting up its rear at night. It loves ILLUMISE’s sweet aroma.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It emits light from its tail to communicate. It loves the sweet aroma given off by ILLUMISE.
flavorText.black-white: It communicates with others by lighting up its rear at night. It loves Illumise’s sweet aroma.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It communicates with others by lighting up its rear at night. It loves Illumise’s sweet aroma.
flavorText.x-y: It communicates with others by lighting up its rear at night. It loves Illumise’s sweet aroma.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: With the arrival of night, Volbeat emits light from its tail. It communicates with others by adjusting the intensity and flashing of its light. This Pokémon is attracted by the sweet aroma of Illumise.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: ILLUMISE attracts a swarm of VOLBEAT using a sweet fragrance. Once the VOLBEAT have gathered, this POKéMON leads the lit-up swarm in drawing geometric designs on the canvas of the night sky.
flavorText.emerald: A nocturnal POKéMON that becomes active upon nightfall. It leads a VOLBEAT swarm to draw patterns in the night sky. Over 200 different patterns have been confirmed.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It guides VOLBEAT to draw signs in night skies. There are scientists that study the patterns it creates.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: With its sweet aroma, it guides VOLBEAT to draw signs with light in the night sky.
flavorText.platinum: With its sweet aroma, it guides VOLBEAT to draw signs with light in the night sky.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: Its fragrance attracts a swarm of VOLBEAT, so they draw over 200 patterns in the night sky.
flavorText.black-white: With its sweet aroma, it guides Volbeat to draw signs with light in the night sky.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: With its sweet aroma, it guides Volbeat to draw signs with light in the night sky.
flavorText.x-y: Its fragrance attracts a swarm of Volbeat, so they draw over 200 patterns in the night sky.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Illumise attracts a swarm of Volbeat using a sweet fragrance. Once the Volbeat have gathered, this Pokémon leads the lit-up swarm in drawing geometric designs on the canvas of the night sky.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: ROSELIA shoots sharp thorns as projectiles at any opponent that tries to steal the flowers on its arms. The aroma of this POKéMON brings serenity to living things.
flavorText.emerald: A ROSELIA that drinks nutritionally rich springwater blooms with lovely flowers. The fragrance of its flowers has the effect of making its foes careless.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: Its flowers give off a relaxing fragrance. The stronger its aroma, the healthier the ROSELIA is.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: ROSELIA raised on clean drinking water are known to grow vividly colored flowers.
flavorText.platinum: The more healthy the ROSELIA, the more pleasant its flowers’ aroma. Its scent deeply relaxes people.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: ROSELIA that drink nutritionally rich springwater are said to reveal rare coloration when they bloom.
flavorText.black-white: The more healthy the Roselia, the more pleasant its flowers’ aroma. Its scent deeply relaxes people.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It uses the different poisons in each hand separately when it attacks. The stronger its aroma, the healthier it is.
flavorText.x-y: It uses the different poisons in each hand separately when it attacks. The stronger its aroma, the healthier it is.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Roselia shoots sharp thorns as projectiles at any opponent that tries to steal the flowers on its arms. The aroma of this Pokémon brings serenity to living things.
flavorText.sword-shield: Its flowers give off a relaxing fragrance. The stronger its aroma, the healthier the Roselia is.
flavorText.legends-arceus: Though beautiful, it has highly poisonous thorns. There is an old tradition in my homeland wherein one would send these thorns to an opponent to challenge them to a duel.

flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It has a small heart and brain. Its stomach comprises most of its body, with enzymes to dissolve anything.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: Virtually all of GULPIN’s body is its stomach. As a result, it can swallow something its own size. This POKéMON’s stomach contains a special fluid that digests anything.
flavorText.emerald: This POKéMON’s stomach fluid can even digest scrap iron. In one gulp, it can swallow something that is as large as itself.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: There is nothing its stomach can’t digest. While it is digesting, vile, overpowering gases are expelled.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: Almost all its body is its stomach. Its harsh digestive juices quickly dissolve anything it swallows.
flavorText.platinum: Almost all its body is its stomach. Its harsh digestive juices quickly dissolve anything it swallows.
flavorText.black-white: Almost all its body is its stomach. Its harsh digestive juices quickly dissolve anything it swallows.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Almost all its body is its stomach. Its harsh digestive juices quickly dissolve anything it swallows.
flavorText.x-y: It has a small heart and brain. Its stomach comprises most of its body, with enzymes to dissolve anything.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Virtually all of Gulpin’s body is its stomach. As a result, it can swallow something its own size. This Pokémon’s stomach contains a special fluid that digests anything.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: When SWALOT spots prey, it spurts out a hideously toxic fluid from its pores and sprays the target. Once the prey has weakened, this POKéMON gulps it down whole with its cavernous mouth.
flavorText.emerald: Its powerful stomach acid is capable of digesting almost anything. The one thing in the whole world a SWALOT can’t digest is its own stomach.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It can swallow a tire whole in one gulp. It secretes a horribly toxic fluid from the pores on its body.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It swallows anything whole. It sweats toxic fluids from its follicles to douse foes.
flavorText.platinum: It swallows anything whole. It sweats toxic fluids from its follicles to douse foes.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It gulps anything that fits in its mouth. Its special enzymes can dissolve anything.
flavorText.black-white: It swallows anything whole. It sweats toxic fluids from its follicles to douse foes.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It swallows anything whole. It sweats toxic fluids from its follicles to douse foes.
flavorText.x-y: It swallows anything whole. It sweats toxic fluids from its follicles to douse foes.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: When Swalot spots prey, it spurts out a hideously toxic fluid from its pores and sprays the target. Once the prey has weakened, this Pokémon gulps it down whole with its cavernous mouth.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: CARVANHA’s strongly developed jaws and its sharply pointed fangs pack the destructive power to rip out boat hulls. Many boats have been attacked and sunk by this POKéMON.
flavorText.emerald: CARVANHA attack ships in swarms, making them sink. Although it is said to be a very vicious POKéMON, it timidly flees as soon as it finds itself alone.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It lives in massive rivers that course through jungles. It swarms prey that enter its territory.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: They swarm any foe that invades their territory. Their sharp fangs can tear out boat hulls.
flavorText.platinum: They swarm any foe that invades their territory. Their sharp fangs can tear out boat hulls.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: They form packs to attack boats and rip out their hulls to sink them. They live in rivers in the jungle.
flavorText.black-white: They swarm any foe that invades their territory. Their sharp fangs can tear out boat hulls.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: They swarm any foe that invades their territory. Their sharp fangs can tear out boat hulls.
flavorText.x-y: They form packs to attack boats and rip out their hulls to sink them. They live in rivers in the jungle.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Carvanha’s strongly developed jaws and its sharply pointed fangs pack the destructive power to rip out boat hulls. Many boats have been attacked and sunk by this Pokémon.
flavorText.sun-moon: Each school has its own territory. Any intruders are mercilessly attacked with fangs bared.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: They’re such cowards that they won’t hunt alone. When five or so of them get together, they suddenly turn ferocious!
flavorText.sword-shield: It won’t attack while it’s alone—not even if it spots prey. Instead, it waits for other Carvanha to join it, and then the Pokémon attack as a group.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: Nicknamed “the bully of the sea,” SHARPEDO is widely feared. Its cruel fangs grow back immediately if they snap off. Just one of these POKéMON can thoroughly tear apart a supertanker.
flavorText.emerald: The vicious and sly gangster of the sea. Its skin is specially textured to minimize drag in water. Its speed tops out at over 75 miles per hour.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: The ruffian of the seas, it has fangs that crunch through iron. It swims by jetting water from its rear.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: Its fangs rip through sheet iron. It swims at 75 mph and is known as “The Bully of the Sea.”
flavorText.platinum: Its fangs rip through sheet iron. It swims at 75 mph and is known as “The Bully of the Sea.”
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It can swim at speeds of 75 mph by jetting seawater through its body. It is the bandit of the sea.
flavorText.black-white: Its fangs rip through sheet iron. It swims at 75 mph and is known as “The Bully of the Sea.”
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Its fangs rip through sheet iron. It swims at 75 mph and is known as “The Bully of the Sea.”
flavorText.x-y: Its fangs rip through sheet iron. It swims at 75 mph and is known as “The Bully of the Sea.”
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Nicknamed “the bully of the sea,” Sharpedo is widely feared. Its cruel fangs grow back immediately if they snap off. Just one of these Pokémon can thoroughly tear apart a supertanker.
flavorText.sun-moon: It pursues its prey at speeds of 75 mph and finishes them off with fangs that can crush iron. It is known as the bully of the sea.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: People believe that carrying one of its discarded fangs will prevent mishaps at sea, so the fangs are made into accessories.
flavorText.sword-shield: As soon as it catches the scent of prey, Sharpedo will jet seawater from its backside, hurtling toward the target to attack at 75 mph.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: WAILMER’s nostrils are located above its eyes. This playful POKéMON loves to startle people by forcefully snorting out seawater it stores inside its body out of its nostrils.
flavorText.emerald: While this POKéMON usually lives in the sea, it can survive on land, although not too long. It loses vitality if its body becomes dried out.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: When it sucks in a large volume of seawater, it becomes like a big, bouncy ball. It eats a ton of food daily.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: On sunny days, it lands on beaches to bounce like a ball and play. It spouts water from its nose.
flavorText.platinum: On sunny days, it lands on beaches to bounce like a ball and play. It spouts water from its nose.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It bounces playfully like a ball. The more seawater it swallows, the higher it bounces.
flavorText.black-white: On sunny days, it lands on beaches to bounce like a ball and play. It spouts water from its nose.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It eats one ton of food every day. It plays by shooting stored seawater out its blowholes with great force.
flavorText.x-y: It bounces playfully like a ball. The more seawater it swallows, the higher it bounces.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Wailmer’s nostrils are located above its eyes. This playful Pokémon loves to startle people by forcefully snorting out seawater it stores inside its body out of its nostrils.
flavorText.sun-moon: It loves to startle people. It fills itself up with seawater and plays by bouncing around like a ball.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: It swims along with its mouth open and swallows down seawater along with its food. It sprays excess water out of its nostrils.
flavorText.sword-shield: It shows off by spraying jets of seawater from the nostrils above its eyes. It eats a solid ton of Wishiwashi every day.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: WAILORD is the largest of all identified POKéMON up to now. This giant POKéMON swims languorously in the vast open sea, eating massive amounts of food at once with its enormous mouth.
flavorText.emerald: It breathes through nostrils that it raises above the sea. By inhaling to its maximum capacity, a WAILORD can dive close to 10,000 feet beneath the waves.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It is among the largest of all POKéMON. It herds prey in a pack then swallows the massed prey in one gulp.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: The biggest of all Pokémon. It can dive to a depth of almost 10,000 feet on only one breath.
flavorText.platinum: The biggest of all Pokémon. It can dive to a depth of almost 10,000 feet on only one breath.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It is the largest of all identified Pokémon. They jump as a pack to herd their prey.
flavorText.black-white: The biggest of all Pokémon. It can dive to a depth of almost 10,000 feet on only one breath.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It can sometimes knock out opponents with the shock created by breaching and crashing its big body onto the water.
flavorText.x-y: It can sometimes knock out opponents with the shock created by breaching and crashing its big body onto the water.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Wailord is the largest of all identified Pokémon up to now. This giant Pokémon swims languorously in the vast open sea, eating massive amounts of food at once with its enormous mouth.
flavorText.sun-moon: Wailord pursue their prey in pods. With their large mouths, they can swallow entire schools of Wishiwashi whole.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: They eat so many fish Pokémon that when Wailord become too numerous, fishermen have to chase them off.
flavorText.sword-shield: It can sometimes knock out opponents with the shock created by breaching and crashing its big body onto the water.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: NUMEL is extremely dull witted - it doesn’t notice being hit. However, it can’t stand hunger for even a second. This POKéMON’s body is a seething cauldron of boiling magma.
flavorText.emerald: A NUMEL stores boiling magma in the hump on its back. It is a hardy POKéMON that can transport a 220-pound load. It has served humans at work since long ago.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: Magma of almost 2,200 degrees Fahrenheit courses through its body. When it grows cold, the magma hardens and slows it.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: Its humped back stores intensely hot magma. In rain, the magma cools, slowing its movement.
flavorText.platinum: Its humped back stores intensely hot magma. In rain, the magma cools, slowing its movement.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: The flaming magma it stores in the hump on its back is the source of its tremendous power.
flavorText.black-white: Its humped back stores intensely hot magma. In rain, the magma cools, slowing its movement.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: The magma in its body reaches 2,200 degrees F. Its hump gets smaller when it uses Fire-type moves.
flavorText.x-y: Its humped back stores intensely hot magma. In rain, the magma cools, slowing its movement.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Numel is extremely dull witted—it doesn’t notice being hit. However, it can’t stand hunger for even a second. This Pokémon’s body is a seething cauldron of boiling magma.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: CAMERUPT has a volcano inside its body. Magma of 18,000 degrees F courses through its body. Occasionally, the humps on this POKéMON’s back erupt, spewing the superheated magma.
flavorText.emerald: A POKéMON that lives in the crater of a volcano. Every 10 years, the volcanoes on its back erupt violently. Research is under way on the cause of eruption.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: If angered, the humps on its back erupt in a shower of molten lava. It lives in the craters of volcanoes.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It has volcanoes on its back. If magma builds up in its body, it shudders, then erupts violently.
flavorText.platinum: It has volcanoes on its back. If magma builds up in its body, it shudders, then erupts violently.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It lives in the crater of a volcano. It is well known that the humps on its back erupt every 10 years.
flavorText.black-white: It has volcanoes on its back. If magma builds up in its body, it shudders, then erupts violently.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: The volcanoes on its back have a major eruption every 10 years--or whenever it becomes really angry.
flavorText.x-y: The volcanoes on its back have a major eruption every 10 years--or whenever it becomes really angry.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Camerupt has a volcano inside its body. Magma of 18,000 degrees Fahrenheit courses through its body. Occasionally, the humps on this Pokémon’s back erupt, spewing the superheated magma.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: TORKOAL digs through mountains in search of coal. If it finds some, it fills hollow spaces on its shell with the coal and burns it. If it is attacked, this POKéMON spouts thick black smoke to beat a retreat.
flavorText.emerald: It battles using energy it gets from burning coal. When loosing smoke from its nostrils, it lets off a sound that is similar to a locomotive’s horn.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It burns coal inside its shell. If it is attacked, it belches thick, black smoke and flees.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It burns coal inside its shell for energy. It blows out black soot if it is endangered.
flavorText.platinum: It burns coal inside its shell for energy. It blows out black soot if it is endangered.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: You find abandoned coal mines full of them. They dig tirelessly in search of coal.
flavorText.black-white: It burns coal inside its shell for energy. It blows out black soot if it is endangered.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It burns coal inside its shell for energy. It blows out black soot if it is endangered.
flavorText.x-y: You find abandoned coal mines full of them. They dig tirelessly in search of coal.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Torkoal digs through mountains in search of coal. If it finds some, it fills hollow spaces on its shell with the coal and burns it. If it is attacked, this Pokémon spouts thick black smoke to beat a retreat.
flavorText.sun-moon: Coal is the source of Torkoal’s energy. Large amounts of coal can be found in the mountains where they live.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: You can tell how it’s feeling by the smoke spouting from its shell. Tremendous velocity is a sign of good health.
flavorText.sword-shield: It burns coal inside its shell for energy. It blows out black soot if it is endangered.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: SPOINK bounces around on its tail. The shock of its bouncing makes its heart pump. As a result, this POKéMON cannot afford to stop bouncing - if it stops, its heart will stop.
flavorText.emerald: A POKéMON that manipulates psychic power at will. It doesn’t stop bouncing even when it is asleep. It loves eating mushrooms that grow underground.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It apparently dies if it stops bouncing about. It carries a pearl from CLAMPERL on its head.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It bounces constantly, using its tail like a spring. The shock of bouncing keeps its heart beating.
flavorText.platinum: It bounces constantly, using its tail like a spring. The shock of bouncing keeps its heart beating.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It bounces around on its tail to keep its heart pumping. It carries a pearl from CLAMPERL on its head.
flavorText.black-white: It bounces constantly, using its tail like a spring. The shock of bouncing keeps its heart beating.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Using its tail like a spring, it keeps its heart beating by bouncing constantly. If it stops, it dies.
flavorText.x-y: It bounces constantly, using its tail like a spring. The shock of bouncing keeps its heart beating.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Spoink bounces around on its tail. The shock of its bouncing makes its heart pump. As a result, this Pokémon cannot afford to stop bouncing—if it stops, its heart will stop.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: GRUMPIG uses the black pearls on its body to amplify its psychic power waves for gaining total control over its foe. When this POKéMON uses its special power, its snorting breath grows labored.
flavorText.emerald: It stores power in the black pearls on its forehead. When it uses psychic power, it performs an odd dance step. Its style of dancing became hugely popular overseas.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It can gain control over foes by doing odd dance steps. The black pearls on its forehead are precious gems.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It uses black pearls to amplify its psycho-power. It does an odd dance to gain control over foes.
flavorText.platinum: It uses black pearls to amplify its psycho-power. It does an odd dance to gain control over foes.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It can perform odd dance steps to influence foes. Its style of dancing became hugely popular overseas.
flavorText.black-white: It uses black pearls to amplify its psycho-power. It does an odd dance to gain control over foes.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It uses black pearls to amplify its psychic power. It does a strange dance to control foes’ minds.
flavorText.x-y: It uses black pearls to amplify its psychic power. It does a strange dance to control foes’ minds.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Grumpig uses the black pearls on its body to amplify its psychic power waves for gaining total control over its foe. When this Pokémon uses its special power, its snorting breath grows labored.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: All the SPINDA that exist in the world are said to have utterly unique spot patterns. The shaky, tottering steps of this POKéMON give it the appearance of dancing.
flavorText.emerald: It is distinguished by a pattern of spots that is always different. Its unsteady, tottering walk has the effect of fouling its foe’s aim.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: No two SPINDA are said to have identical patterns. It confuses foes with its stumbling motions.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: No two SPINDA have the same pattern of spots. Its tottering step fouls the aim of foes.
flavorText.platinum: No two SPINDA have the same pattern of spots. Its tottering step fouls the aim of foes.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: The chances of two SPINDA having identical spot patterns is less than one in four billion.
flavorText.black-white: No two Spinda have the same pattern of spots. Its tottering step fouls the aim of foes.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: No two Spinda have the same pattern of spots. Its tottering step fouls the aim of foes.
flavorText.x-y: No two Spinda have the same pattern of spots. Its tottering step fouls the aim of foes.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: All the Spinda that exist in the world are said to have utterly unique spot patterns. The shaky, tottering steps of this Pokémon give it the appearance of dancing.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: Each Spinda’s spot pattern is different. With its stumbling movements, it evades opponents’ attacks brilliantly!
flavorText.sun-moon: Its steps are staggering and unsteady, but Spinda thinks it’s walking in a straight line.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: TRAPINCH’s nest is a sloped, bowl-like pit dug in sand. This POKéMON patiently waits for prey to tumble down the pit. Its giant jaws have enough strength to crush even boulders.
flavorText.emerald: Its big jaws crunch through boulders. Because its head is so big, it has a hard time getting back upright if it tips over onto its back.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It lives in arid deserts. It makes a sloping pit trap in sand where it patiently awaits prey.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It makes a conical pit in desert sand and lies in wait at the bottom for prey to come tumbling down.
flavorText.platinum: It makes a conical pit in desert sand and lies in wait at the bottom for prey to come tumbling down.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: Its nest is a sloped, bowl-like pit in the desert. Once something has fallen in, there is no escape.
flavorText.black-white: It makes a conical pit in desert sand and lies in wait at the bottom for prey to come tumbling down.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It makes an inescapable conical pit and lies in wait at the bottom for prey to come tumbling down.
flavorText.x-y: It lives in arid deserts. It makes a sloping pit trap in sand where it patiently awaits prey.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Trapinch’s nest is a sloped, bowl-like pit dug in sand. This Pokémon patiently waits for prey to tumble down the pit. Its giant jaws have enough strength to crush even boulders.
flavorText.sun-moon: It can live for a week without eating a thing. It waits patiently at the bottom of its nest for prey to appear.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: Its jaws are strong enough to crush rocks but so heavy that it can’t get up if it flips over. Sandile seize those moments as their chance.
flavorText.sword-shield: Its nest is a sloped, bowl-like pit in the desert. Once something has fallen in, there is no escape.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: To make prey faint, VIBRAVA generates ultrasonic waves by vigorously making its two wings vibrate. This POKéMON’s ultrasonic waves are so powerful, they can bring on headaches in people.
flavorText.emerald: It looses ultrasonic waves by rubbing its wings together. Since a VIBRAVA’s wings are still in the process of growing, it can only fly short distances.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It generates ultrasonic waves by violently flapping its wings. After making its prey faint, it melts the prey with acid.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It violently shudders its wings, generating ultrasonic waves to induce headaches in people.
flavorText.platinum: It violently shudders its wings, generating ultrasonic waves to induce headaches in people.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It vibrates its wings vigorously, creating ultrasonic waves that cause serious headaches.
flavorText.black-white: It violently shudders its wings, generating ultrasonic waves to induce headaches in people.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: The ultrasonic waves it generates by rubbing its two wings together cause severe headaches.
flavorText.x-y: The ultrasonic waves it generates by rubbing its two wings together cause severe headaches.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: To make prey faint, Vibrava generates ultrasonic waves by vigorously making its two wings vibrate. This Pokémon’s ultrasonic waves are so powerful, they can bring on headaches in people.
flavorText.sun-moon: Rather than using its underdeveloped wings for flight, it rubs them together, producing ultrasonic waves to attack its enemies.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: It vibrates its wings to generate ultrasonic waves, causing its prey to faint. Then it buries the prey alive in the sand to preserve it.
flavorText.sword-shield: The ultrasonic waves it generates by rubbing its two wings together cause severe headaches.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: FLYGON is nicknamed “the elemental spirit of the desert.” Because its flapping wings whip up a cloud of sand, this POKéMON is always enveloped in a sandstorm while flying.
flavorText.emerald: The flapping of its wings sounds like singing. To prevent detection by enemies, it hides itself by flapping up a cloud of desert sand.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It hides itself by kicking up desert sand with its wings. Red covers shield its eyes from sand.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It whips up sandstorms with powerful flaps of its wings. It is known as “The Desert Spirit.”
flavorText.platinum: It whips up sandstorms with powerful flaps of its wings. It is known as “The Desert Spirit.”
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It is nicknamed “The Desert Spirit” because the flapping of its wings sounds like a woman singing.
flavorText.black-white: It whips up sandstorms with powerful flaps of its wings. It is known as “The Desert Spirit.”
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Known as “The Desert Spirit,” this Pokémon hides in the sandstorms it causes by beating its wings.
flavorText.x-y: It hides itself by kicking up desert sand with its wings. Red covers shield its eyes from sand.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Flygon is nicknamed “the elemental spirit of the desert.” Because its flapping wings whip up a cloud of sand, this Pokémon is always enveloped in a sandstorm while flying.
flavorText.sun-moon: The flapping of its wings sounds something like singing. Those lured by the sound are enveloped in a sandstorm, becoming Flygon’s prey.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: By flapping their wings, Flygon cause sandstorms that conceal Krookodile. The team then splits the prey they catch.
flavorText.sword-shield: This Pokémon hides in the heart of sandstorms it creates and seldom appears where people can see it.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: CACNEA lives in arid locations such as deserts. It releases a strong aroma from its flower to attract prey. When prey comes near, this POKéMON shoots sharp thorns from its body to bring the victim down.
flavorText.emerald: CACNEA live in deserts with virtually no rainfall. It battles by swinging its thick, spiked arms. Once a year, a yellow flower blooms.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It prefers harsh environments such as deserts. It can survive for 30 days on water stored in its body.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: By storing water in its body, this desert dweller can survive for 30 days without water.
flavorText.platinum: By storing water in its body, this desert dweller can survive for 30 days without water.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It lives in arid locations. Its yellow flowers bloom once a year.
flavorText.black-white: By storing water in its body, this desert dweller can survive for 30 days without water.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: By storing water in its body, this desert dweller can survive for 30 days without water.
flavorText.x-y: It lives in arid locations. Its yellow flowers bloom once a year.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Cacnea lives in arid locations such as deserts. It releases a strong aroma from its flower to attract prey. When prey comes near, this Pokémon shoots sharp thorns from its body to bring the victim down.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: During the daytime, CACTURNE remains unmoving so that it does not lose any moisture to the harsh desert sun. This POKéMON becomes active at night when the temperature drops.
flavorText.emerald: After spending thousands of years in harsh deserts, its blood transformed into the same substances as sand. It is nocturnal, so it hunts at night.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It lives in deserts. It becomes active at night when it hunts for prey exhausted from the desert’s heat.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It becomes active at night, seeking prey that is exhausted from the day’s desert heat.
flavorText.platinum: It becomes active at night, seeking prey that is exhausted from the day’s desert heat.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: Packs of them follow travelers through the desert until the travelers can no longer move.
flavorText.black-white: It becomes active at night, seeking prey that is exhausted from the day’s desert heat.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It becomes active at night, seeking prey that is exhausted from the day’s desert heat.
flavorText.x-y: It becomes active at night, seeking prey that is exhausted from the day’s desert heat.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: During the daytime, Cacturne remains unmoving so that it does not lose any moisture to the harsh desert sun. This Pokémon becomes active at night when the temperature drops.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: SWABLU has light and fluffy wings that are like cottony clouds. This POKéMON is not frightened of people. It lands on the heads of people and sits there like a cotton-fluff hat.
flavorText.emerald: A POKéMON that has wings like cottony clouds. After enduring winter, in which little food is available, SWABLU flocks move closer to towns in the spring.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It constantly grooms its cotton-like wings. It takes a shower to clean itself if it becomes dirty.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: Its wings are like cotton tufts. If it perches on someone’s head, it looks like a cotton hat.
flavorText.platinum: It can’t relax if it or its surroundings are not clean. It wipes off dirt with its wings.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: Its wings bring cottony clouds to mind. It grooms with springwater and loves to sit on heads.
flavorText.black-white: It can’t relax if it or its surroundings are not clean. It wipes off dirt with its wings.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: For some reason, it likes to land on people’s heads softly and act like it’s a hat.
flavorText.x-y: For some reason, it likes to land on people’s heads softly and act like it’s a hat.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Swablu has light and fluffy wings that are like cottony clouds. This Pokémon is not frightened of people. It lands on the heads of people and sits there like a cotton-fluff hat.
flavorText.sword-shield: Its cottony wings are full of air, making them light and fluffy to the touch. Swablu takes diligent care of its wings.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: ALTARIA dances and wheels through the sky among billowing, cotton-like clouds. By singing melodies in its crystal-clear voice, this POKéMON makes its listeners experience dreamy wonderment.
flavorText.emerald: It hums in a beautiful soprano voice. It flies among white clouds in the blue sky. It launches intensely hot fireballs from its mouth.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: If you hear a beautiful melody trilling deep among mountains far from people, it is ALTARIA’s humming.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It looks like a fluffy cloud when it is in flight. It hums with its soprano voice.
flavorText.platinum: If it bonds with a person, it will gently envelop the friend with its soft wings, then hum.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It flies gracefully through the sky. Its melodic humming makes you feel like you’re in a dream.
flavorText.black-white: If it bonds with a person, it will gently envelop the friend with its soft wings, then hum.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: On sunny days, it flies freely through the sky and blends into the clouds. It sings in a beautiful soprano.
flavorText.x-y: It flies gracefully through the sky. Its melodic humming makes you feel like you’re in a dream.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Altaria dances and wheels through the sky among billowing, cotton-like clouds. By singing melodies in its crystal-clear voice, this Pokémon makes its listeners experience dreamy wonderment.
flavorText.sword-shield: As it flies in a calm and relaxed manner, Altaria performs a humming song that would enrapture any audience.

flavorText.x-y: It has feuded with Seviper for many generations. Its sharp claws are its biggest weapons.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: Memories of battling its arch-rival SEVIPER are etched into every cell of ZANGOOSE’s body. This POKéMON adroitly dodges attacks with incredible agility.
flavorText.emerald: When it battles, it stands on its hind legs and attacks with its sharply clawed forelegs. Its fur bristles if it encounters any SEVIPER.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: If it comes across a SEVIPER, its fur bristles and it assumes its battle pose. Its sharp claws are its best weapon.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It has feuded with SEVIPER for many generations. Its sharp claws are its biggest weapons.
flavorText.platinum: It has feuded with SEVIPER for many generations. Its sharp claws are its biggest weapons.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: Its fur would all stand on end if it smelled a SEVIPER nearby. Its sharp claws tear up its foes.
flavorText.black-white: It has feuded with Seviper for many generations. Its sharp claws are its biggest weapons.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It’s Seviper’s archrival. To threaten those it encounters, it fans out the claws on its front paws.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Memories of battling its archrival Seviper are etched into every cell of Zangoose’s body. This Pokémon adroitly dodges attacks with incredible agility.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: SEVIPER shares a generations-long feud with ZANGOOSE. The scars on its body are evidence of vicious battles. This POKéMON attacks using its sword- edged tail.
flavorText.emerald: SEVIPER and ZANGOOSE are eternal rivals. It counters a ZANGOOSE’s dazzling agility with its swordlike tail, which also oozes a horrible poison.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It sharpens its swordlike tail on hard rocks. It hides in tall grass and strikes unwary prey with venomous fangs.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: For many generations, it has feuded with ZANGOOSE. It whets its bladed tail on rocks for battle.
flavorText.platinum: For many generations, it has feuded with ZANGOOSE. It whets its bladed tail on rocks for battle.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: In battle, it uses its bladed tail to counter any ZANGOOSE. It secretes a deadly venom in its tail.
flavorText.black-white: For many generations, it has feuded with Zangoose. It whets its bladed tail on rocks for battle.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Constant polishing makes the edge of the blade on its tail extremely sharp. It’s Zangoose’s archrival.
flavorText.x-y: In battle, it uses its bladed tail to counter any Zangoose. It secretes a deadly venom in its tail.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Seviper shares a generations-long feud with Zangoose. The scars on its body are evidence of vicious battles. This Pokémon attacks using its sword-edged tail.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: LUNATONE was discovered at a location where a meteorite fell. As a result, some people theorize that this POKéMON came from space. However, no one has been able to prove this theory so far.
flavorText.emerald: It becomes very active on the night of a full moon. This POKéMON was first discovered 40 years ago at the site of a meteor strike.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: Its health ebbs and flows with the lunar cycle. It brims with power when exposed to the light of the full moon.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: Because it turns active on nights of the full moon, it is said to have some link to the lunar phases.
flavorText.platinum: Because it turns active on nights of the full moon, it is said to have some link to the lunar phases.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It was discovered at the site of a meteor strike 40 years ago. Its stare can lull its foes to sleep.
flavorText.black-white: Because it turns active on nights of the full moon, it is said to have some link to the lunar phases.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: The phase of the moon apparently has some effect on its power. It’s active on the night of a full moon.
flavorText.x-y: Because it turns active on nights of the full moon, it is said to have some link to the lunar phases.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Lunatone was discovered at a location where a meteoroid fell. As a result, some people theorize that this Pokémon came from space. However, no one has been able to prove this theory so far.
flavorText.sword-shield: The phase of the moon apparently has some effect on its power. It’s active on the night of a full moon.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: SOLROCK is a new species of POKéMON that is said to have fallen from space. It floats in air and moves silently. In battle, this POKéMON releases intensely bright light.
flavorText.emerald: Solar energy is the source of this POKéMON’s power. On sunny days, groups of SOLROCK line up facing the sun and absorb its light.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It absorbs solar energy during the day. Always expressionless, it can sense what its foe is thinking.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: A new Pokémon species, rumored to be from the sun. It gives off light while spinning.
flavorText.platinum: A new Pokémon species, rumored to be from the sun. It gives off light while spinning.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: When it rotates itself, it gives off light similar to the sun, thus blinding its foes.
flavorText.black-white: A new Pokémon species, rumored to be from the sun. It gives off light while spinning.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Solar energy is the source of its power, so it is strong during the daytime. When it spins, its body shines.
flavorText.x-y: Solar energy is the source of its power, so it is strong during the daytime. When it spins, its body shines.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Solrock is a new species of Pokémon that is said to have fallen from space. It floats in air and moves silently. In battle, this Pokémon releases intensely bright light.
flavorText.sword-shield: When it rotates itself, it gives off light similar to the sun, thus blinding its foes.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: BARBOACH’s sensitive whiskers serve as a superb radar system. This POKéMON hides in mud, leaving only its two whiskers exposed while it waits for prey to come along.
flavorText.emerald: Its body is covered with a slimy film. The film acts as a barrier to prevent germs in muddy water from entering the BARBOACH’s body.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It probes muddy riverbeds with its two long whiskers. A slimy film protects its body.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It coats its entire body with a slimy fluid so it can squirm and slip away if grabbed.
flavorText.platinum: Its slimy body is hard to grasp. In one region, it is said to have been born from hardened mud.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: BARBOACH uses its whiskers to taste things just as a person uses his or her tongue to taste things.
flavorText.black-white: Its slimy body is hard to grasp. In one region, it is said to have been born from hardened mud.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Its slimy body is hard to grasp. In one region, it is said to have been born from hardened mud.
flavorText.x-y: It coats its entire body with a slimy fluid so it can squirm and slip away if grabbed.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Barboach’s sensitive whiskers serve as a superb radar system. This Pokémon hides in mud, leaving only its two whiskers exposed while it waits for prey to come along.
flavorText.sun-moon: Its two whiskers provide a sensitive radar. Even in muddy waters, it can detect its prey’s location.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: Its entire body is gooey. When pecked at by bird Pokémon, it slips and slides its way to freedom.
flavorText.sword-shield: Its slimy body is hard to grasp. In one region, it is said to have been born from hardened mud.
flavorText.legends-arceus: Makes its home in swamps with murky water. The poor visibility hides this Pokémon from predators, and the slime on its body makes grasping it difficult.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: WHISCASH is extremely territorial. Just one of these POKéMON will claim a large pond as its exclusive territory. If a foe approaches it, it thrashes about and triggers a massive earthquake.
flavorText.emerald: Mysteriously, it can foretell earthquakes. In the daytime, it sleeps in mud at the bottom of a pond. When it awakens, it continually feeds throughout the night.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It makes its nest at the bottom of swamps. It will eat anything - if it is alive, WHISCASH will eat it.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It is very territorial. It repels foes by setting off tremors that extend over a three-mile radius.
flavorText.platinum: It is extremely protective of its territory. If any foe approaches, it attacks using vicious tremors.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It claims a large swamp to itself. If a foe comes near it, it sets off tremors by thrashing around.
flavorText.black-white: It is extremely protective of its territory. If any foe approaches, it attacks using vicious tremors.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It is extremely protective of its territory. If any foe approaches, it attacks using vicious tremors.
flavorText.x-y: It claims a large swamp to itself. If a foe comes near it, it sets off tremors by thrashing around.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Whiscash is extremely territorial. Just one of these Pokémon will claim a large pond as its exclusive territory. If a foe approaches it, it thrashes about and triggers a massive earthquake.
flavorText.sun-moon: A glutton that devours anything that moves, it quietly lurks at the bottom of swamps, lying in wait for prey.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: Whiscash shakes the ground at high intensities to intimidate its opponents. It swallows its prey whole—along with mud from the swamp floor.
flavorText.sword-shield: It makes its nest at the bottom of swamps. It will eat anything—if it is alive, Whiscash will eat it.
flavorText.legends-arceus: Strikes its caudal fin against the swamp bed to shake the ground and startle its prey. It will then swallow the fleeing prey whole. People mistook this behavior as the cause of earthquakes.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: CORPHISH were originally foreign POKéMON that were imported as pets. They eventually turned up in the wild. This POKéMON is very hardy and has greatly increased its population.
flavorText.emerald: Once it grips prey with its large pincers, it will never let go, no matter what. It is a hardy POKéMON that can thrive in any environment.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It came from overseas. It is a very hardy creature that will quickly proliferate, even in polluted streams.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: Its hardy vitality enables it to adapt to any environment. Its pincers will never release prey.
flavorText.platinum: Its hardy vitality enables it to adapt to any environment. Its pincers will never release prey.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It was originally a Pokémon from afar that escaped to the wild. It can adapt to the dirtiest river.
flavorText.black-white: Its hardy vitality enables it to adapt to any environment. Its pincers will never release prey.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: No matter how dirty the water in the river, it will adapt and thrive. It has a strong will to survive.
flavorText.x-y: No matter how dirty the water in the river, it will adapt and thrive. It has a strong will to survive.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Corphish were originally foreign Pokémon that were imported as pets. They eventually turned up in the wild. This Pokémon is very hardy and has greatly increased its population.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: Individuals that have been set free by Trainers who could no longer raise them have become common, and they can now be found in Alola.
flavorText.sword-shield: No matter how dirty the water in the river, it will adapt and thrive. It has a strong will to survive.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: CRAWDAUNT has an extremely violent nature that compels it to challenge other living things to battle. Other life-forms refuse to live in ponds inhabited by this POKéMON, making them desolate places.
flavorText.emerald: A brutish POKéMON that loves to battle. A veteran CRAWDAUNT that has prevailed in hundreds of battles has giant pincers marked with countless scars.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: A rough customer that wildly flails its giant claws. It is said to be extremely hard to raise.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It is a ruffian that uses its pincers to pick up and toss out other Pokémon from its pond.
flavorText.platinum: It is a ruffian that uses its pincers to pick up and toss out other Pokémon from its pond.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: A brutish Pokémon that loves to battle. It will crash itself into any foe that approaches its nest.
flavorText.black-white: It is a ruffian that uses its pincers to pick up and toss out other Pokémon from its pond.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Loving to battle, this Pokémon pinches all Pokémon that enter its territory with its pincers and throws them out.
flavorText.x-y: It is a ruffian that uses its pincers to pick up and toss out other Pokémon from its pond.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Crawdaunt has an extremely violent nature that compels it to challenge other living things to battle. Other life-forms refuse to live in ponds inhabited by this Pokémon, making them desolate places.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: Its temperament is rough and it loves to fight, but as soon as its pincers break off, it turns cowardly. It stays timid until they grow back.
flavorText.sword-shield: A rough customer that wildly flails its giant claws. It is said to be extremely hard to raise.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: BALTOY moves while spinning around on its one foot. Primitive wall paintings depicting this POKéMON living among people were discovered in some ancient ruins.
flavorText.emerald: A BALTOY moves by spinning on its single foot. It has been depicted in murals adorning the walls of a once-bustling city in an ancient age.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It was discovered in ancient ruins. While moving, it constantly spins. It stands on one foot even when asleep.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It moves by spinning on its foot. It is a rare Pokémon that was discovered in ancient ruins.
flavorText.platinum: It moves by spinning on its foot. It is a rare Pokémon that was discovered in ancient ruins.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It moves while spinning around on its single foot. Some BALTOY have been seen spinning on their heads.
flavorText.black-white: It moves by spinning on its foot. It is a rare Pokémon that was discovered in ancient ruins.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Discovered in ancient ruins, it moves by spinning around and forms a group when it finds others.
flavorText.x-y: It moves while spinning around on its single foot. Some Baltoy have been seen spinning on their heads.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Baltoy moves while spinning around on its one foot. Primitive wall paintings depicting this Pokémon living among people were discovered in some ancient ruins.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: Depictions of Pokémon similar to Baltoy have been found on the walls of caves where primitive humans lived.
flavorText.sword-shield: It moves while spinning around on its single foot. Some Baltoy have been seen spinning on their heads.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: CLAYDOL are said to be dolls of mud made by primitive humans and brought to life by exposure to a mysterious ray. This POKéMON moves about while levitating.
flavorText.emerald: A CLAYDOL sleeps while hovering in midair. Its arms are separate from its body. They are kept floating by the POKéMON’s manipulation of psychic power.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It appears to have been born from clay dolls made by ancient people. It uses telekinesis to float and move.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: An ancient clay figurine that came to life as a Pokémon from exposure to a mysterious ray of light.
flavorText.platinum: An ancient clay figurine that came to life as a Pokémon from exposure to a mysterious ray of light.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It is said that it originates from clay dolls made by an ancient civilization.
flavorText.black-white: An ancient clay figurine that came to life as a Pokémon from exposure to a mysterious ray of light.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: This mysterious Pokémon started life as an ancient clay figurine made over 20,000 years ago.
flavorText.x-y: An ancient clay figurine that came to life as a Pokémon from exposure to a mysterious ray of light.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Claydol are said to be dolls of mud made by primitive humans and brought to life by exposure to a mysterious ray. This Pokémon moves about while levitating.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: If it gets wet, its body melts. When rain starts to fall, it wraps its whole body up with its psychic powers to protect itself.
flavorText.sword-shield: This mysterious Pokémon started life as an ancient clay figurine made over 20,000 years ago.

flavorText.black-2-white-2: It lived on the seafloor 100 million years ago and was reanimated scientifically.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: LILEEP became extinct approximately a hundred million years ago. This ancient POKéMON attaches itself to a rock on the seafloor and catches approaching prey using tentacles shaped like flower petals.
flavorText.emerald: It disguises itself as seaweed by making its tentacles sway. Unsuspecting prey that come too close are swallowed whole. It became extinct 100 million years ago.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It became extinct roughly 100 million years ago. It was regenerated from a fossil using advanced techniques.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It lived on the seafloor 100 million years ago and was reanimated scientifically.
flavorText.platinum: It lived on the seafloor 100 million years ago and was reanimated scientifically.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It disguises its tentacles as flowers to attract and catch prey. It became extinct in ancient times.
flavorText.black-white: It lived on the seafloor 100 million years ago and was reanimated scientifically.
flavorText.x-y: It disguises its tentacles as flowers to attract and catch prey. It became extinct in ancient times.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Lileep became extinct approximately a hundred million years ago. This ancient Pokémon attaches itself to a rock on the seafloor and catches approaching prey using tentacles shaped like flower petals.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: In ancient times, it lived in warm seas. It disguised itself as seaweed to ambush its prey and devoured them whole when they got close.
flavorText.sword-shield: This Pokémon was restored from a fossil. Lileep once lived in warm seas that existed approximately 100,000,000 years ago.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: CRADILY roams around the ocean floor in search of food. This POKéMON freely extends its tree trunk-like neck and captures unwary prey using its eight tentacles.
flavorText.emerald: It drags its heavy body along the seafloor. It makes its nest in the shallows of warm seas. CRADILY can be seen on beaches when the tide goes out.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It ensnares prey with its eight tentacles. It then melts the prey with a strong acid before feeding.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It lives in the shallows of warm seas. When the tide goes out, it digs up prey from beaches.
flavorText.platinum: It lives in the shallows of warm seas. When the tide goes out, it digs up prey from beaches.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It lives in warm seas. Its heavy body weighs it down so it won’t get washed away in rough weather.
flavorText.black-white: It lives in the shallows of warm seas. When the tide goes out, it digs up prey from beaches.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It lives in the shallows of warm seas. When the tide goes out, it digs up prey from beaches.
flavorText.x-y: It lives in the shallows of warm seas. When the tide goes out, it digs up prey from beaches.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Cradily roams around the ocean floor in search of food. This Pokémon freely extends its tree trunk-like neck and captures unwary prey using its eight tentacles.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: Normally, it lived on shallow sea shoals. When the tide went out, this Pokémon came up on land to search for prey.
flavorText.sword-shield: It has short legs and can’t walk very fast, but its neck and tentacles can extend to over three times their usual length to nab distant prey.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: ANORITH was regenerated from a prehistoric fossil. This primitive POKéMON once lived in warm seas. It grips its prey firmly between its two large claws.
flavorText.emerald: It was resurrected from a fossil using the power of science. It swims by undulating the eight wings at its sides. They were feet that adapted to life in the sea.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It is a kind of POKéMON progenitor. It uses its extending claws to catch prey hiding among rocks on the seafloor.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: A Pokémon ancestor that was reanimated from a fossil. It lived in the sea and hunted with claws.
flavorText.platinum: A Pokémon ancestor that was reanimated from a fossil. It lived in the sea and hunted with claws.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: An ancestral Pokémon that lived in the ocean. Over time, its eight feet transformed into wings.
flavorText.black-white: A Pokémon ancestor that was reanimated from a fossil. It lived in the sea and hunted with claws.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: A Pokémon ancestor that was reanimated from a fossil. It lived in the sea and hunted with claws.
flavorText.x-y: It is a kind of Pokémon progenitor. It uses its extending claws to catch prey hiding among rocks on the seafloor.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Anorith was regenerated from a prehistoric fossil. This primitive Pokémon once lived in warm seas. It grips its prey firmly between its two large claws.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: When restored Anorith are released into the ocean, they don’t thrive, because the water composition has changed since their era.
flavorText.sword-shield: This Pokémon was restored from a fossil. Anorith lived in the ocean about 100,000,000 years ago, hunting with its pair of claws.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: ARMALDO’s tough armor makes all attacks bounce off. This POKéMON’s two enormous claws can be freely extended or contracted. They have the power to punch right through a steel slab.
flavorText.emerald: ARMALDO usually lives on land. However, when it hunts for prey, it dives beneath the ocean. It swims around using its two large wings.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: Protected by a hard shell, its body is very sturdy. It skewers prey with its claws to feed.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It went ashore after evolving. Its entire body is clad in a sturdy armor.
flavorText.platinum: It went ashore after evolving. Its entire body is clad in a sturdy armor.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: Its enormous, retractable claws can cut through most anything. Its entire body is clad in sturdy plates.
flavorText.black-white: It went ashore after evolving. Its entire body is clad in a sturdy armor.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It went ashore after evolving. Its entire body is clad in a sturdy armor.
flavorText.x-y: Its enormous, retractable claws can cut through most anything. Its entire body is clad in sturdy plates.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Armaldo’s tough armor makes all attacks bounce off. This Pokémon’s two enormous claws can be freely extended or contracted. They have the power to punch right through a steel slab.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: It lived on land and went out into the sea to hunt for prey. Its sharp claws were its greatest weapon.
flavorText.sword-shield: After evolution, this Pokémon emerged onto land. Its lower body has become stronger, and blows from its tail are devastating.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: FEEBAS’s fins are ragged and tattered from the start of its life. Because of its shoddy appearance, this POKéMON is largely ignored. It is capable of living in both the sea and in rivers.
flavorText.emerald: FEEBAS live in ponds that are heavily infested with weeds. Because of its hopelessly shabby appearance, it seems as if few TRAINERS raise it.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: Ridiculed for its shabby appearance, it is ignored by researchers. It lives in ponds choked with weeds.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It is famous for its shabby appearance. While populous, they tend to cluster in set locations.
flavorText.platinum: It is a shabby and ugly Pokémon. However, it is very hardy and can survive on little water.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It is the shabbiest Pokémon of all. It forms in schools and lives at the bottom of rivers.
flavorText.black-white: It is a shabby and ugly Pokémon. However, it is very hardy and can survive on little water.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It is a shabby and ugly Pokémon. However, it is very hardy and can survive on little water.
flavorText.x-y: It eats anything, so it can even live in polluted streams and lakes. No one pays any attention to it.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Feebas’s fins are ragged and tattered from the start of its life. Because of its shoddy appearance, this Pokémon is largely ignored. It is capable of living in both the sea and in rivers.
flavorText.sun-moon: A tough Pokémon that is perfectly fine even in dirty water. However, due to its ragged, shabby appearance, it isn’t popular.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: They look ragged, so no one catches them. They look like they’d taste bad, so predators won’t eat them. And their numbers continue to grow.
flavorText.sword-shield: Although unattractive and unpopular, this Pokémon’s marvelous vitality has made it a subject of research.

flavorText.firered-leafgreen: MILOTIC is breathtakingly beautiful. Those that see it are said to forget their combative spirits.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: MILOTIC is said to be the most beautiful of all the POKéMON. It has the power to becalm such emotions as anger and hostility to quell bitter feuding.
flavorText.emerald: It is said to live at the bottom of large lakes. Considered to be the most beautiful of all POKéMON, it has been depicted in paintings and statues.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: When people bicker, it is said to arise from the depths of lakes to becalm violent hearts.
flavorText.platinum: Its lovely scales are described as rainbow colored. They change color depending on the viewing angle.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It’s said that a glimpse of a MILOTIC and its beauty will calm any hostile emotions you’re feeling.
flavorText.black-white: Its lovely scales are described as rainbow colored. They change color depending on the viewing angle.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Its lovely scales are described as rainbow colored. They change color depending on the viewing angle.
flavorText.x-y: Milotic is breathtakingly beautiful. Those that see it are said to forget their combative spirits.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Milotic is said to be the most beautiful of all the Pokémon. It has the power to becalm such emotions as anger and hostility to quell bitter feuding.
flavorText.sun-moon: Milotic has provided inspiration to many artists. It has even been referred to as the most beautiful Pokémon of all.
