flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: While Milotic is said to be the most beautiful Pokémon, Trainers who like Feebas and have raised it are seemingly disappointed by Milotic.
flavorText.sword-shield: Milotic has provided inspiration to many artists. It has even been referred to as the most beautiful Pokémon of all.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: CASTFORM’s appearance changes with the weather. This POKéMON gained the ability to use the vast power of nature to protect its tiny body.
flavorText.emerald: It alters its form depending on the weather. Changes in the climate such as the temperature and humidity appear to affect its cellular structure.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It has the ability to change its form into the sun, the rain, or a snow cloud, depending on the weather.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: Its appearance changes with the weather. Recently, its molecules were found to be just like water.
flavorText.platinum: Its appearance changes with the weather. Recently, its molecules were found to be just like water.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: This Pokémon can change its cells, taking different forms based on the temperature and humidity.
flavorText.black-white: Its appearance changes with the weather. Recently, its molecules were found to be just like water.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Temperature and weather affect its cellular structure, so this Pokémon changes form according to the weather.
flavorText.x-y: This Pokémon can change its cells, taking different forms based on the temperature and humidity.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Castform’s appearance changes with the weather. This Pokémon gained the ability to use the vast power of nature to protect its tiny body.
flavorText.sun-moon: It changes its form depending on the weather. Changes in the temperature or humidity appear to affect its cellular structure.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: Although its form changes with the weather, that is apparently the result of a chemical reaction and not the result of its own free will.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: KECLEON is capable of changing its body colors at will to blend in with its surroundings. There is one exception - this POKéMON can’t change the zigzag pattern on its belly.
flavorText.emerald: A POKéMON that has the ability to alter its body colors to match its surroundings. A KECLEON reverts to its original colors if it is startled.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It changes body color to blend in with its surroundings. It also changes color if it is happy or sad.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It can freely change its body’s color. The zigzag pattern on its belly doesn’t change, however.
flavorText.platinum: It can freely change its body’s color. The zigzag pattern on its belly doesn’t change, however.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It changes its shading to match its surroundings so it can sneak up on prey. Only its belly patterns stay fixed.
flavorText.black-white: It can freely change its body’s color. The zigzag pattern on its belly doesn’t change, however.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It can freely change its body’s color. The zigzag pattern on its belly doesn’t change, however.
flavorText.x-y: It can freely change its body’s color. The zigzag pattern on its belly doesn’t change, however.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Kecleon is capable of changing its body colors at will to blend in with its surroundings. There is one exception—this Pokémon can’t change the zigzag pattern on its belly.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: It changes its hue to blend into its surroundings. If no one takes notice of it for too long, it will pout and never reveal itself.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: SHUPPET is attracted by feelings of jealousy and vindictiveness. If someone develops strong feelings of vengeance, this POKéMON will appear in a swarm and line up beneath the eaves of that person’s home.
flavorText.emerald: This POKéMON roams about deep in the night seeking such negative emotions as grudges and envy. It retreats to its nest when the sun begins to rise.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It loves to feed on feelings like envy and malice. Its upright horn catches the emotions of people.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It loves vengeful emotions and hangs in rows under the eaves of houses where vengeful people live.
flavorText.platinum: It loves vengeful emotions and hangs in rows under the eaves of houses where vengeful people live.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It uses its horn to feed on envy and malice, or so it’s said. It’s very active at night.
flavorText.black-white: It loves vengeful emotions and hangs in rows under the eaves of houses where vengeful people live.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It feeds on the dark emotions of sadness and hatred, which make it grow steadily stronger.
flavorText.x-y: It uses its horn to feed on envy and malice-- or so it’s said. It’s very active at night.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Shuppet is attracted by feelings of jealousy and vindictiveness. If someone develops strong feelings of vengeance, this Pokémon will appear in a swarm and line up beneath the eaves of that person’s home.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: It eats up emotions like malice, jealousy, and resentment, so some people are grateful for its presence.

flavorText.diamond-pearl: A doll that became a Pokémon over its grudge from being junked. It seeks the child that disowned it.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: BANETTE generates energy for laying strong curses by sticking pins into its own body. This POKéMON was originally a pitiful plush doll that was thrown away.
flavorText.emerald: An abandoned plush doll became this POKéMON. They are said to live in garbage dumps and wander about in search of the children that threw them away.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: Strong feelings of hatred turned a puppet into a POKéMON. If it opens its mouth, its cursed energy escapes.
flavorText.platinum: A doll that became a Pokémon over its grudge from being junked. It seeks the child that disowned it.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: This Pokémon developed from an abandoned doll that amassed a grudge. It is seen in dark alleys.
flavorText.black-white: A doll that became a Pokémon over its grudge from being junked. It seeks the child that disowned it.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: A doll that became a Pokémon over its grudge of being thrown away. It seeks the child who disowned it.
flavorText.x-y: A doll that became a Pokémon over its grudge from being junked. It seeks the child that disowned it.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Banette generates energy for laying strong curses by sticking pins into its own body. This Pokémon was originally a pitiful plush doll that was thrown away.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: It’s a stuffed toy that was thrown away and became possessed, ever searching for the one who threw it away so it can exact its revenge.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: DUSKULL can pass through any wall no matter how thick it may be. Once this POKéMON chooses a target, it will doggedly pursue the intended victim until the break of dawn.
flavorText.emerald: A glare from its single scarlet eye makes even burly grown-ups freeze in utter fear. It is a nocturnal POKéMON that roams about under the cloak of darkness.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: Making itself invisible, it silently sneaks up to prey. It has the ability to slip through thick walls.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It doggedly pursues its prey wherever it goes. However, the chase is abandoned at sunrise.
flavorText.platinum: It loves the crying of children. It startles bad kids by passing through walls and making them cry.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: If it finds bad children who won’t listen to their parents, it will spirit them away--or so it’s said.
flavorText.black-white: It loves the crying of children. It startles bad kids by passing through walls and making them cry.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It loves the crying of children. It startles bad kids by passing through walls and making them cry.
flavorText.x-y: It doggedly pursues its prey wherever it goes. However, the chase is abandoned at sunrise.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Duskull can pass through any wall no matter how thick it may be. Once this Pokémon chooses a target, it will doggedly pursue the intended victim until the break of dawn.
flavorText.sword-shield: If it finds bad children who won’t listen to their parents, it will spirit them away—or so it’s said.
flavorText.legends-arceus: I've heard that the children of Hisui all begin to behave once they've been told the story of how this Pokémon roams about before the witching hour to spirit away misbehaving children.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: DUSCLOPS’s body is completely hollow - there is nothing at all inside. It is said that its body is like a black hole. This POKéMON will absorb anything into its body, but nothing will ever come back out.
flavorText.emerald: It is thought that its body is hollow with only a spectral ball of fire burning inside. However, no one has been able to confirm this theory as fact.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: Its body is entirely hollow. When it opens its mouth, it sucks everything in as if it were a black hole.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: Its body is hollow. It is said that those who look into its body are sucked into the void.
flavorText.platinum: It seeks drifting will-o’-the-wisps and sucks them into its empty body. What happens inside is a mystery.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: Anyone who dares peer into its body to see its spectral ball of fire will have their spirit stolen away.
flavorText.black-white: It seeks drifting will-o’-the-wisps and sucks them into its empty body. What happens inside is a mystery.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It seeks drifting will-o’-the-wisps and sucks them into its empty body. What happens inside is a mystery.
flavorText.x-y: Anyone who dares peer into its body to see its spectral ball of fire will have their spirit stolen away.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Dusclops’s body is completely hollow—there is nothing at all inside. It is said that its body is like a black hole. This Pokémon will absorb anything into its body, but nothing will ever come back out.
flavorText.sword-shield: Its body is entirely hollow. When it opens its mouth, it sucks everything in as if it were a black hole.
flavorText.legends-arceus: There are rumors that peeking inside its bandage-wrapped body will cause one to get pulled in through the gaps between the bandages, never to return. I've been too scared to verify.

flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It lives in tropical jungles. The bunch of fruit around its neck is delicious. The fruit grows twice a year.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: The bunches of fruit around TROPIUS’s neck are very popular with children. This POKéMON loves fruit, and eats it continuously. Apparently, its love for fruit resulted in its own outgrowth of fruit.
flavorText.emerald: It flies by flapping its broad leaves. The bunch of fruit that grows around its neck is deliciously sweet. In the spring, it scatters pollen from its neck.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: Because it continually ate only its favorite fruit, the fruit started growing around its neck.
flavorText.platinum: Delicious fruits grew out from around its neck because it always ate the same kind of fruit.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: The bunch of fruit around its neck ripens twice a year and is delicious. It’s a highly favored tropical snack.
flavorText.black-white: Delicious fruits grew out from around its neck because it always ate the same kind of fruit.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It flies by flapping its broad leaves and gives the sweet, delicious fruit around its neck to children.
flavorText.x-y: It flies by flapping its broad leaves and gives the sweet, delicious fruit around its neck to children.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: The bunches of fruit around Tropius’s neck are very popular with children. This Pokémon loves fruit, and eats it continuously. Apparently, its love for fruit resulted in its own outgrowth of fruit.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: The bunches of fruit growing around the necks of Tropius in Alola are especially sweet compared to those in other regions.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: CHIMECHO makes its cries echo inside its hollow body. When this POKéMON becomes enraged, its cries result in ultrasonic waves that have the power to knock foes flying.
flavorText.emerald: They fly about very actively when the hot season arrives. They communicate among themselves using seven different and distinguishing cries.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It travels by riding on winds. It cleverly uses its long tail to pluck nuts and berries, which it loves to eat.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: To knock foes flying, it makes the air shudder with its cries. It converses using seven cries.
flavorText.platinum: Its cries echo inside its hollow body to emerge as beautiful notes for startling and repelling foes.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It uses the sucker on its head to hang from a tree or from eaves. It can produce seven different tones.
flavorText.black-white: Its cries echo inside its hollow body to emerge as beautiful notes for startling and repelling foes.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Its cries echo inside its hollow body to emerge as beautiful notes for startling and repelling foes.
flavorText.x-y: It uses the sucker on its head to hang from a tree or from eaves. It can produce seven different tones.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Chimecho makes its cries echo inside its hollow body. When this Pokémon becomes enraged, its cries result in ultrasonic waves that have the power to knock foes flying.
flavorText.legends-arceus: Can emit waves of air powerful enough to knock out prey taller than itself. I hypothesize that it amplifies the faint sound of wind within its body.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: Every time ABSOL appears before people, it is followed by a disaster such as an earthquake or a tidal wave. As a result, it came to be known as the disaster POKéMON.
flavorText.emerald: It sharply senses even subtle changes in the sky and the land to predict natural disasters. It is a long-lived POKéMON that has a life-span of 100 years.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It appears when it senses an impending natural disaster. As a result, it was mistaken as a doom-bringer.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It senses coming disasters and appears before people only to warn them of impending danger.
flavorText.platinum: Rumored to sense disasters with its horn, it became a target. It fled deep into the mountains.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It has the ability to foretell natural disasters. Its life span is over a hundred years.
flavorText.black-white: Rumored to sense disasters with its horn, it became a target. It fled deep into the mountains.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It appears from deep in the mountains to warn people about upcoming disasters it has sensed with its horn.
flavorText.x-y: It senses coming disasters and appears before people only to warn them of impending danger.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Every time Absol appears before people, it is followed by a disaster such as an earthquake or a tidal wave. As a result, it came to be known as the disaster Pokémon.
flavorText.sun-moon: Long ago, superstitions were spread about it, saying it brought disaster. This fed a hatred of it, and it was driven deep into the mountains.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: The only thing unlucky about Absol is its appearance. It protects fields and warns people of disaster, so one ought to be grateful for it.
flavorText.sword-shield: Swift as the wind, Absol races through fields and mountains. Its curved, bow-like horn is acutely sensitive to the warning signs of natural disasters.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: WYNAUT can always be seen with a big, happy smile on its face. Look at its tail to determine if it is angry. When angered, this POKéMON will be slapping the ground with its tail.
flavorText.emerald: A WYNAUT loves to eat sweet fruits. It cleverly picks fruits using its earlike arms. They gather in fruit gardens, drawn by the fragrance.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It tends to move in a pack with others. They cluster in a tight group to sleep in a cave.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It grows strong by pushing up against others en masse. It loves eating sweet fruit.
flavorText.platinum: It grows strong by pushing up against others en masse. It loves eating sweet fruit.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It tends to move in a pack. Individuals squash against one another to toughen their spirits.
flavorText.black-white: It grows strong by pushing up against others en masse. It loves eating sweet fruit.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It grows strong by pushing up against others en masse. It loves eating sweet fruit.
flavorText.x-y: It tends to move in a pack with others. They cluster in a tight group to sleep in a cave.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Wynaut can always be seen with a big, happy smile on its face. Look at its tail to determine if it is angry. When angered, this Pokémon will be slapping the ground with its tail.
flavorText.sword-shield: It tends to move in a pack. Individuals squash against one another to toughen their spirits.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: SNORUNT live in regions with heavy snowfall. In seasons without snow, such as spring and summer, this POKéMON steals away to live quietly among stalactites and stalagmites deep in caverns.
flavorText.emerald: They tend to move about in groups of around five SNORUNT. In snowy regions, it is said that when they are seen late at night, snowfall will arrive by morning.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It is said that a home visited by a SNORUNT will prosper. It can withstand cold of minus 150 degrees Fahrenheit.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: In the snow country, certain folklore says a house will prosper if a SNORUNT lives there.
flavorText.platinum: It is said that several SNORUNT gather under giant leaves and live together in harmony.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It’s said that if they are seen at midnight, they’ll cause heavy snow. They eat snow and ice to survive.
flavorText.black-white: It is said that several Snorunt gather under giant leaves and live together in harmony.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It is said that several Snorunt gather under giant leaves and live together in harmony.
flavorText.x-y: It is said that several Snorunt gather under giant leaves and live together in harmony.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Snorunt live in regions with heavy snowfall. In seasons without snow, such as spring and summer, this Pokémon steals away to live quietly among stalactites and stalagmites deep in caverns.
flavorText.sun-moon: Their numbers seem to have rapidly increased in Alola. Custom has it that houses where Snorunt live will be prosperous for generations to come.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: It feeds mainly on ice and snow. It’s only able to survive in a limited number of places in the warm Alola region.
flavorText.sword-shield: It’s said that if they are seen at midnight, they’ll cause heavy snow. They eat snow and ice to survive.
flavorText.legends-arceus: Arrives alongside the first snow. It's thought that homes Snorunt visit will prosper for many generations. By tradition, one might offer a lump of ice made from pure water at one's front door.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: GLALIE has a body made of rock, which it hardens with an armor of ice. This POKéMON has the ability to freeze moisture in the atmosphere into any shape it desires.
flavorText.emerald: A GLALIE has the power to instantaneously freeze moisture in the atmosphere. A dazzling cloud of diamondlike ice crystals forms around its body.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It has a body of ice that won’t melt, even with fire. It can instantly freeze moisture in the atmosphere.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: To protect itself, it clads its body in an armor of ice, made by freezing moisture in the air.
flavorText.platinum: It prevents prey from escaping by instantaneously freezing moisture in the air.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It can instantly freeze moisture in the atmosphere. It uses this power to freeze its foes.
flavorText.black-white: It prevents prey from escaping by instantaneously freezing moisture in the air.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It prevents prey from escaping by instantaneously freezing moisture in the air.
flavorText.x-y: To protect itself, it clad its body in an armor of ice, made by freezing moisture in the air.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Glalie has a body made of rock, which it hardens with an armor of ice. This Pokémon has the ability to freeze moisture in the atmosphere into any shape it desires.
flavorText.sun-moon: Legend says a boulder on an icy mountain absorbed the distress and regrets of a stranded mountaineer, giving rise to Glalie.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: It freezes its prey and chews them whole. However, it prefers to eat Pokémon like Vanillite that are already frozen.
flavorText.sword-shield: It has a body of ice that won’t melt, even with fire. It can instantly freeze moisture in the atmosphere.
flavorText.legends-arceus: It covers its body with an armor of ice harder than steel. Uses its breath to freeze prey, which it then devours as if they were frozen desserts.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: SPHEAL is much faster rolling than walking to get around. When groups of this POKéMON eat, they all clap at once to show their pleasure. Because of this, their mealtimes are noisy.
flavorText.emerald: It is completely covered with plushy fur. As a result, it never feels the cold even when it is rolling about on ice floes or diving in the sea.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: Its body is covered in fluffy fur. The fur keeps it from feeling cold while it is rolling on ice.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It rolls across ice floes to reach shore because its body is poorly shaped for swimming.
flavorText.platinum: It rolls across ice floes to reach shore because its body is poorly shaped for swimming.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It crosses the oceans by rolling itself on drifting ice. Fluffy fur keeps it warm when the temperature is below freezing.
flavorText.black-white: It rolls across ice floes to reach shore because its body is poorly shaped for swimming.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: They can’t swim well yet, and they move much faster by rolling. When they’re happy, they clap fins.
flavorText.x-y: They can’t swim well yet, and they move much faster by rolling. When they’re happy, they clap fins.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Spheal is much faster rolling than walking to get around. When groups of this Pokémon eat, they all clap at once to show their pleasure. Because of this, their mealtimes are noisy.
flavorText.sword-shield: This Pokémon’s body is covered in blubber and impressively round. It’s faster for Spheal to roll around than walk.
flavorText.legends-arceus: During the season when drift ice approaches the shore, Spheal prefers living on the ice—where fewer predators lurk—rather than the land. Its fur retains heat superbly and resists harsh cold.

flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It has a very sensitive nose. It touches new things with its nose to examine them.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: SEALEO has the habit of always juggling on the tip of its nose anything it sees for the first time. This POKéMON occasionally entertains itself by balancing and rolling a SPHEAL on its nose.
flavorText.emerald: SEALEO live in herds on ice floes. Using its powerful flippers, it shatters ice. It dives into the sea to hunt prey five times a day.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It touches new things with its nose to test for smell and feel. It plays by spinning SPHEAL on its nose.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It habitually spins things on its nose. By doing so, it learns textures and odors.
flavorText.platinum: It habitually spins things on its nose. By doing so, it learns textures and odors.
flavorText.black-white: It habitually spins things on its nose. By doing so, it learns textures and odors.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Be it Spheal or Poké Ball, it will spin any round object on its nose with the greatest of ease.
flavorText.x-y: It has a very sensitive nose. It touches new things with its nose to examine them.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Sealeo has the habit of always juggling on the tip of its nose anything it sees for the first time. This Pokémon occasionally entertains itself by balancing and rolling a Spheal on its nose.
flavorText.sword-shield: Sealeo live on top of drift ice. They go swimming when they’re on the hunt, seeking out their prey by scent.
flavorText.legends-arceus: Its white whiskers are very sensitive. Sealeo will balance Spheal on the tip of its nose, checking its scent and its feel to be sure the Spheal is healthy.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: WALREIN’s two massively developed tusks can totally shatter blocks of ice weighing ten tons with one blow. This POKéMON’s thick coat of blubber insulates it from subzero temperatures.
flavorText.emerald: To protect its herd, the leader battles anything that invades its territory, even at the cost of its life. Its tusks may snap off in battle.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It swims through icy seas while shattering ice floes with its large tusks. It is protected by its thick blubber.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It shatters ice with its big tusks. Its thick blubber repels not only the cold, but also enemy attacks.
flavorText.platinum: It shatters ice with its big tusks. Its thick blubber repels not only the cold, but also enemy attacks.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It shatters drift ice with its strong tusks. Its thick layer of blubber repels enemy attacks.
flavorText.black-white: It shatters ice with its big tusks. Its thick blubber repels not only the cold, but also enemy attacks.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Not only does its thick blubber keep it warm, it also protects it from attacks. It shatters ice with its prized tusks.
flavorText.x-y: It shatters ice with its big tusks. Its thick blubber repels not only the cold, but also enemy attacks.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Walrein’s two massively developed tusks can totally shatter blocks of ice weighing 10 tons with one blow. This Pokémon’s thick coat of blubber insulates it from subzero temperatures.
flavorText.sword-shield: Walrein form herds of 20 to 30 individuals. When a threat appears, the herd’s leader will protect the group with its life.
flavorText.legends-arceus: Its thick tusks are strong enough to shatter drift ice. They have been known to break, but they will grow back by the next year. The Hisui region is well known for these broken tusks.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: CLAMPERL’s sturdy shell is not only good for protection - it is also used for clamping and catching prey. A fully grown CLAMPERL’s shell will be scored with nicks and scratches all over.
flavorText.emerald: A CLAMPERL slams its shell closed on prey to prevent escape. The pearl it creates upon evolution is said to be infused with a mysterious energy.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It is protected by a sturdy shell. Once in a lifetime, it makes a magnificent pearl.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It makes a single pearl during its lifetime. The pearl is said to amplify psychic power.
flavorText.platinum: It makes a single pearl during its lifetime. The pearl is said to amplify psychic power.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: When it evolves, it makes a mysterious pearl that amplifies psychic powers when it’s held.
flavorText.black-white: It makes a single pearl during its lifetime. The pearl is said to amplify psychic power.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It makes a single pearl during its lifetime. The pearl is said to amplify psychic power.
flavorText.x-y: When it evolves, it makes a mysterious pearl that amplifies psychic powers when it’s held.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Clamperl’s sturdy shell is not only good for protection—it is also used for clamping and catching prey. A fully grown Clamperl’s shell will be scored with nicks and scratches all over.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: Despite its appearance, it’s carnivorous. It clamps down on its prey with both sides of its shell and doesn’t let go until they stop moving.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: HUNTAIL’s presence went unnoticed by people for a long time because it lives at extreme depths in the sea. This POKéMON’s eyes can see clearly even in the murky dark depths of the ocean.
flavorText.emerald: To withstand the crushing pressure of water deep under the sea, its spine is very thick and sturdy. Its tail, which is shaped like a small fish, has eyes that light up.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It lives deep in the sea where no light ever filters down. It lights up its small fishlike tail to attract prey.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It lives deep in the sea. With a tail shaped like a small fish, it attracts unsuspecting prey.
flavorText.platinum: It lives deep in the sea. With a tail shaped like a small fish, it attracts unsuspecting prey.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It lives deep in the pitch-dark sea. It attracts prey by moving its tail in mimicry of a small animal.
flavorText.black-white: It lives deep in the sea. With a tail shaped like a small fish, it attracts unsuspecting prey.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It lives deep in the sea. With a tail shaped like a small fish, it attracts unsuspecting prey.
flavorText.x-y: It lives deep in the sea where no light ever filters down. It lights up its small fishlike tail to attract prey.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Huntail’s presence went unnoticed by people for a long time because it lives at extreme depths in the sea. This Pokémon’s eyes can see clearly even in the murky dark depths of the ocean.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: It’s not the strongest swimmer. It wags its tail to lure in its prey and then gulps them down as soon as they get close.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: GOREBYSS lives in the southern seas at extreme depths. Its body is built to withstand the enormous pressure of water at incredible depths. Because of this, this POKéMON’s body is unharmed by ordinary attacks.
flavorText.emerald: A GOREBYSS siphons the body fluids of prey through its thin, tubular mouth. Its light pink body color turns vivid when it finishes feeding.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: Its swimming form is exquisitely elegant. With its thin mouth, it feeds on seaweed that grows between rocks.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It lives at the bottom of the sea. In the springtime, its pink body turns more vivid for some reason.
flavorText.platinum: It lives at the bottom of the sea. In the springtime, its pink body turns more vivid for some reason.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: Its pink body becomes more vivid with the rise of water temperatures in the springtime.
flavorText.black-white: It lives at the bottom of the sea. In the springtime, its pink body turns more vivid for some reason.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It lives at the bottom of the sea. In the springtime, its pink body turns more vivid for some reason.
flavorText.x-y: It lives at the bottom of the sea. In the springtime, its pink body turns more vivid for some reason.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Gorebyss lives in the southern seas at extreme depths. Its body is built to withstand the enormous pressure of water at incredible depths. Because of this, this Pokémon’s body is unharmed by ordinary attacks.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: The color of its body changes with the water temperature. The coloration of Gorebyss in Alola is almost blindingly vivid.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: RELICANTH is a POKéMON species that existed for a hundred million years without ever changing its form. This ancient POKéMON feeds on microscopic organisms with its toothless mouth.
flavorText.emerald: A POKéMON that was once believed to have been extinct. The species has not changed its form for 100 million years. It walks on the seafloor using its pectoral fins.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It has remained unchanged for 100 million years. It was discovered during a deep-sea exploration.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: A rare Pokémon discovered during a deep-sea exploration. It has not changed in over 100 million years.
flavorText.platinum: A rare Pokémon discovered during a deep-sea exploration. It has not changed in over 100 million years.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: Discovered by chance during deep-sea explorations, it has not changed since ancient times.
flavorText.black-white: A rare Pokémon discovered during a deep-sea exploration. It has not changed in over 100 million years.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: A rare Pokémon discovered during a deep-sea exploration. It has not changed in over 100 million years.
flavorText.x-y: It has remained unchanged for 100 million years. It was discovered during a deep-sea exploration.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Relicanth is a Pokémon species that existed for a hundred million years without ever changing its form. This ancient Pokémon feeds on microscopic organisms with its toothless mouth.
flavorText.sun-moon: Its form has remained the same for one hundred million years. Its body is filled with fat, so it can withstand the water pressure of the deep sea.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: Thought to have gone extinct, Relicanth was given a name that is a variation of the name of the person who discovered it.
flavorText.sword-shield: Rock-hard scales and oil-filled swim bladders allow this Pokémon to survive the intense water pressure of the deep sea.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: LUVDISC live in shallow seas in the tropics. This heart-shaped POKéMON earned its name by swimming after loving couples it spotted in the ocean’s waves.
flavorText.emerald: LUVDISC make the branches of CORSOLA their nests. There is a custom from long ago of giving a LUVDISC as a gift to express one’s feelings of love.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: During the spawning season, countless LUVDISC congregate at coral reefs, turning the waters pink.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It lives in warm seas. It is said that a couple finding this Pokémon will be blessed with eternal love.
flavorText.platinum: It lives in warm seas. It is said that a couple finding this Pokémon will be blessed with eternal love.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: Its heart-shaped body makes it popular. In some places, you would give a LUVDISC to someone you love.
flavorText.black-white: It lives in warm seas. It is said that a couple finding this Pokémon will be blessed with eternal love.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It lives in warm seas. It is said that a couple finding this Pokémon will be blessed with eternal love.
flavorText.x-y: It lives in warm seas. It is said that a couple finding this Pokémon will be blessed with eternal love.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Luvdisc live in shallow seas in the tropics. This heart-shaped Pokémon earned its name by swimming after loving couples it spotted in the ocean’s waves.
flavorText.sun-moon: If a Luvdisc is left on its own, it becomes despondent, leaving itself open to attack. That is when Pelipper snatch them up.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: There was an era when it was overfished due to the rumor that having one of its heart-shaped scales would enable you to find a sweetheart.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: BAGON has a dream of one day soaring in the sky. In doomed efforts to fly, this POKéMON hurls itself off cliffs. As a result of its dives, its head has grown tough and as hard as tempered steel.
flavorText.emerald: Although it is small, this POKéMON is very powerful because its body is a bundle of muscles. It launches head-butts with its ironlike skull.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: Its steel-hard head can shatter boulders. It longingly hopes for wings to grow so it can fly.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: Dreaming of one day flying, it practices by leaping off cliffs every day.
flavorText.platinum: Dreaming of one day flying, it practices by leaping off cliffs every day.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: Its well-developed neck muscles and ironlike head can smash boulders into pieces.
flavorText.black-white: Dreaming of one day flying, it practices by leaping off cliffs every day.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Dreaming of one day flying, it practices by leaping off cliffs every day.
flavorText.x-y: Its well-developed neck muscles and iron-like head can smash boulders into pieces.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Bagon has a dream of one day soaring in the sky. In doomed efforts to fly, this Pokémon hurls itself off cliffs. As a result of its dives, its head has grown tough and as hard as tempered steel.
flavorText.sun-moon: Its belief that it will be able to fly one day is apparently the influence of information carried in its genes.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: Whenever it sees bird Pokémon flying through the sky, it becomes envious and smashes its surroundings to bits with headbutts.
flavorText.sword-shield: Bagon jumps off cliffs every day, trying to grow stronger so that someday it will be able to fly.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: Inside SHELGON’s armor-like shell, cells are in the midst of transformation to create an entirely new body. This POKéMON’s shell is extremely heavy, making its movements sluggish.
flavorText.emerald: It hardly eats while it awaits evolution. It becomes hardier by enduring hunger. Its shell peels off the instant it begins to evolve.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: Its armored body makes all attacks bounce off. The armor is too tough, however, making it heavy and somewhat sluggish.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: Within its rugged shell, its cells have begun changing. The shell peels off the instant it evolves.
flavorText.platinum: Within its rugged shell, its cells have begun changing. The shell peels off the instant it evolves.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It surrounds its body in an iron-hard shell to accumulate enough power to evolve.
flavorText.black-white: Within its rugged shell, its cells have begun changing. The shell peels off the instant it evolves.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Within its rugged shell, its cells have begun changing. The shell peels off the instant it evolves.
flavorText.x-y: Within its rugged shell, its cells have begun changing. The shell peels off the instant it evolves.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Inside Shelgon’s armor-like shell, cells are in the midst of transformation to create an entirely new body. This Pokémon’s shell is extremely heavy, making its movements sluggish.
flavorText.sun-moon: The cells within its shell transform with explosive speed, preparing it for evolution.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: The cells within its body are changing at a bewildering pace. Its hard shell is made from the same substance as bone.
flavorText.sword-shield: This Pokémon has covered its body in a hard shell that has the same composition as bone. Shelgon stores energy for evolution.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: SALAMENCE came about as a result of a strong, long-held dream of growing wings. It is said that this powerful desire triggered a sudden mutation in this POKéMON’s cells, causing it to sprout its magnificent wings.
flavorText.emerald: After many long years, its cellular structure underwent a sudden mutation to grow wings. When angered, it loses all thought and rampages out of control.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It becomes uncontrollable if it is enraged. It destroys everything with shredding claws and fire.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: As a result of its long-held dream of flying, its cellular structure changed, and wings grew out.
flavorText.platinum: As a result of its long-held dream of flying, its cellular structure changed, and wings grew out.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It’s uncontrollable if enraged. It flies around spouting flames and scorching fields and mountains.
flavorText.black-white: As a result of its long-held dream of flying, its cellular structure changed, and wings grew out.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: As a result of its long-held dream of flying, its cellular structure changed, and wings grew out.
flavorText.x-y: It becomes uncontrollable if it is enraged. It destroys everything with shredding claws and fire.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Salamence came about as a result of a strong, long-held dream of growing wings. It is said that this powerful desire triggered a sudden mutation in this Pokémon’s cells, causing it to sprout its magnificent wings.
flavorText.sun-moon: When angered, it loses all sense of itself and destroys everything around it. The destruction will continue until Salamence has tired itself out.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: Overjoyed at finally being able to fly, it flies all over the place and usually doesn’t land until it’s completely exhausted and needs to sleep.
flavorText.sword-shield: Salamence is an unusual Pokémon in that it was able to evolve a body with wings just by constantly wishing to be able to fly.

flavorText.platinum: It converses with others by using magnetic pulses. In a swarm, they move in perfect unison.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: Instead of blood, a powerful magnetic force courses throughout BELDUM’s body. This POKéMON communicates with others by sending controlled pulses of magnetism.
flavorText.emerald: When BELDUM gather in a swarm, they move in perfect unison as if they were but one POKéMON. They communicate with each other using brain waves.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It uses magnetic waves to converse with its kind. All the cells in its body are magnetic.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It converses with others by using magnetic pulses. In a swarm, they move in perfect unison.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: The magnetic force generated by its body repels the ground’s natural magnetism, letting it float.
flavorText.black-white: It converses with others by using magnetic pulses. In a swarm, they move in perfect unison.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Its cells are all magnetic, and it communicates with others by using magnetic pulses.
flavorText.x-y: The magnetic force generated by its body repels the ground’s natural magnetism, letting it float.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Instead of blood, a powerful magnetic force courses throughout Beldum’s body. This Pokémon communicates with others by sending controlled pulses of magnetism.
flavorText.sun-moon: Its cells are all magnets. It uses magnetism to communicate with others of its kind.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: Instead of blood, magnetism flows through its body. When it’s feeling bad, try giving it a magnet.
flavorText.sword-shield: From its rear, Beldum emits a magnetic force that rapidly pulls opponents in. They get skewered on Beldum’s sharp claws.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: When two BELDUM fuse together, METANG is formed. The brains of the BELDUM are joined by a magnetic nervous system. By linking its brains magnetically, this POKéMON generates strong psychokinetic power.
flavorText.emerald: The claws tipping its arms pack the destructive power to tear through thick iron sheets as if they were silk. It flies at over 60 miles per hour.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It floats midair using magnetism. Its body is so tough, even a crash with a jet plane won’t leave a scratch.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It is formed by two BELDUM joining together. Its steel body won’t be scratched if it collides with a jet.
flavorText.platinum: It is formed by two BELDUM joining together. Its steel body won’t be scratched if it collides with a jet.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: When two BELDUM fuse together, a magnetic nervous system places their brains in union.
flavorText.black-white: It is formed by two Beldum joining together. Its steel body won’t be scratched if it collides with a jet.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It is formed by two Beldum joining together. Its two brains are linked, amplifying its psychic power.
flavorText.x-y: It is formed by two Beldum joining together. Its steel body won’t be scratched if it collides with a jet.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: When two Beldum fuse together, Metang is formed. The brains of the Beldum are joined by a magnetic nervous system. By linking its brains magnetically, this Pokémon generates strong psychokinetic power.
flavorText.sun-moon: When two Beldum link together, their psychic power is doubled. Their intelligence, however, remains unchanged.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: With its two brains, it fires powerful psychic energy to stop its prey in their tracks.
flavorText.sword-shield: Two Beldum have become stuck together via their own magnetic forces. With two brains, the resulting Metang has doubled psychic powers.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: METAGROSS has four brains in total. Combined, the four brains can breeze through difficult calculations faster than a supercomputer. This POKéMON can float in the air by tucking in its four legs.
flavorText.emerald: METAGROSS has four brains that are joined by a complex neural network. As a result of integration, this POKéMON is smarter than a supercomputer.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It is formed by two METANG fusing. Its four brains are said to be superior to a supercomputer.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: METANG combined to form it. With four brains, it has the intelligence of a supercomputer.
flavorText.platinum: METANG combined to form it. With four brains, it has the intelligence of a supercomputer.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It folds its four legs when flying. Its four brains are said to be superior to a supercomputer.
flavorText.black-white: Metang combined to form it. With four brains, it has the intelligence of a supercomputer.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: With four linked brains, it’s more intelligent than a supercomputer, and it uses calculations to analyze foes.
flavorText.x-y: With four linked brains, it’s more intelligent than a supercomputer, and it uses calculations to analyze foes.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Metagross has four brains in total. Combined, the four brains can breeze through difficult calculations faster than a supercomputer. This Pokémon can float in the air by tucking in its four legs.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: It analyzes its opponents with more accuracy than a supercomputer, which enables it to calmly back them into a corner.
flavorText.sun-moon: It firmly pins its prey using its four claws and large body. Then the teeth in the mouth on its stomach chew the prey to bits.
flavorText.sword-shield: Because the magnetic powers of these Pokémon get stronger in freezing temperatures, Metagross living on snowy mountains are full of energy.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: REGIROCK was sealed away by people long ago. If this POKéMON’s body is damaged in battle, it is said to seek out suitable rocks on its own to repair itself.
flavorText.emerald: A POKéMON that is made entirely of rocks and boulders. If parts of its body chip off in battle, REGIROCK repairs itself by adding new rocks.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It is entirely composed of rocks with no sign of a brain or heart. It is a mystery even to modern scientists.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: Its entire body is made of rock. If any part chips off in battle, it attaches rocks to repair itself.
flavorText.platinum: Its entire body is made of rock. If any part chips off in battle, it attaches rocks to repair itself.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: The same rocks that form its body have been found in ground layers around the world.
flavorText.black-white: Its entire body is made of rock. If any part chips off in battle, it attaches rocks to repair itself.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Its entire body is made of rock. If any part chips off in battle, it attaches rocks to repair itself.
flavorText.x-y: Its entire body is made of rock. If any part chips off in battle, it attaches rocks to repair itself.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Regirock was sealed away by people long ago. If this Pokémon’s body is damaged in battle, it is said to seek out suitable rocks on its own to repair itself.
flavorText.sword-shield: Every bit of Regirock’s body is made of stone. As parts of its body erode, this Pokémon sticks rocks to itself to repair what’s been lost.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: REGICE’s body was made during an ice age. The deep-frozen body can’t be melted, even by fire. This POKéMON controls frigid air of minus 328 degrees F.
flavorText.emerald: Its entire body is made of Antarctic ice. After extensive studies, researchers believe the ice was formed during an ice age.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: Research revealed that its body is made of the same kind of ice that is found at the South Pole.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: Its body is made of ice from the ice age. It controls frigid air of -328 degrees Fahrenheit.
flavorText.platinum: Its body is made of ice from the ice age. It controls frigid air of -328 degrees Fahrenheit.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It is said to have slept in a glacier for thousands of years. Its body can’t be melted, even by magma.
flavorText.black-white: Its body is made of ice from the ice age. It controls frigid air of -328 degrees Fahrenheit.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Its body is made of ice from the ice age. It controls frigid air of -328 degrees Fahrenheit.
flavorText.x-y: It is said to have slept in a glacier for thousands of years. Its body can’t be melted, even by magma.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Regice’s body was made during an ice age. The deep-frozen body can’t be melted, even by fire. This Pokémon controls frigid air of -328 degrees Fahrenheit.
flavorText.sword-shield: With cold air that can reach temperatures as low as −328 degrees Fahrenheit, Regice instantly freezes any creature that approaches it.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: REGISTEEL has a body that is harder than any kind of metal. Its body is apparently hollow. No one has any idea what this POKéMON eats.
flavorText.emerald: Its body is harder than any other kind of metal. The body metal is composed of a mysterious substance. Not only is it hard, it shrinks and stretches flexibly.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It is sturdier than any kind of metal. It hardened due to pressure underground over tens of thousands of years.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: Tempered by pressure underground over tens of thousands of years, its body cannot be scratched.
flavorText.platinum: Tempered by pressure underground over tens of thousands of years, its body cannot be scratched.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: Its body is said to be harder than any kind of metal. A study has revealed that its body is hollow.
flavorText.black-white: Tempered by pressure underground over tens of thousands of years, its body cannot be scratched.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Tempered by pressure underground over tens of thousands of years, its body cannot be scratched.
flavorText.x-y: Tempered by pressure underground over tens of thousands of years, its body cannot be scratched.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Registeel has a body that is harder than any kind of metal. Its body is apparently hollow. No one has any idea what this Pokémon eats.
flavorText.sword-shield: Registeel’s body is made of a strange material that is flexible enough to stretch and shrink but also more durable than any metal.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: LATIAS is highly sensitive to the emotions of people. If it senses any hostility, this POKéMON ruffles the feathers all over its body and cries shrilly to intimidate the foe.
flavorText.emerald: They make a small herd of only several members. They rarely make contact with people or other POKéMON. They disappear if they sense enemies.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It can telepathically communicate with people. It changes its appearance using its down that refracts light.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: Its body is covered with a down that can refract light in such a way that it becomes invisible.
flavorText.platinum: Its body is covered with a down that can refract light in such a way that it becomes invisible.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It communicates using telepathy. Its body is covered in down that refracts light to make it invisible.
flavorText.black-white: Its body is covered with a down that can refract light in such a way that it becomes invisible.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Its body is covered with a down that can refract light in such a way that it becomes invisible.
flavorText.x-y: It communicates using telepathy. Its body is covered in down that refracts light to make it invisible.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Latias is highly sensitive to the emotions of people. If it senses any hostility, this Pokémon ruffles the feathers all over its body and cries shrilly to intimidate the foe.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: LATIOS has the ability to make its foe see an image of what it has seen or imagines in its head. This POKéMON is intelligent and understands human speech.
flavorText.emerald: Even in hiding, it can detect the locations of others and sense their emotions since it has telepathy. Its intelligence allows it to understand human languages.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It has a docile temperament and dislikes fighting. Tucking in its forelegs, it can fly faster than a jet plane.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: A highly intelligent Pokémon. By folding back its wings in flight, it can overtake jet planes.
flavorText.platinum: A highly intelligent Pokémon. By folding back its wings in flight, it can overtake jet planes.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It understands human speech and is highly intelligent. It is a tender Pokémon that dislikes fighting.
flavorText.black-white: A highly intelligent Pokémon. By folding back its wings in flight, it can overtake jet planes.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: A highly intelligent Pokémon. By folding back its wings in flight, it can overtake jet planes.
flavorText.x-y: A highly intelligent Pokémon. By folding back its wings in flight, it can overtake jet planes.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Latios has the ability to make others see an image of what it has seen or imagines in its head. This Pokémon is intelligent and understands human speech.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: KYOGRE has the power to create massive rain clouds that cover the entire sky and bring about torrential downpours. This POKéMON saved people who were suffering from droughts.
flavorText.emerald: KYOGRE has appeared in mythology as the creator of the sea. After long years of feuding with GROUDON, it took to sleep at the bottom of the sea.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: This POKéMON is said to have expanded the sea by bringing heavy rains. It has the power to control water.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It is said to have widened the seas by causing downpours. It had been asleep in a marine trench.
flavorText.platinum: It is said to have widened the seas by causing downpours. It had been asleep in a marine trench.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: A mythical Pokémon said to have swelled the seas with rain and tidal waves. It battled with GROUDON.
flavorText.black-white: It is said to have widened the seas by causing downpours. It had been asleep in a marine trench.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It is said to have widened the seas by causing downpours. It had been asleep in a marine trench.
flavorText.x-y: A mythical Pokémon said to have swelled the seas with rain and tidal waves. It battled with Groudon.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Through Primal Reversion and with nature’s full power, it will take back its true form. It can summon storms that cause the sea levels to rise.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: GROUDON has long been described in mythology as the POKéMON that raised lands and expanded continents. This POKéMON took to sleep after a cataclysmic battle with KYOGRE.
flavorText.emerald: GROUDON has appeared in mythology as the creator of the land. It sleeps in magma underground and is said to make volcanoes erupt on awakening.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: This legendary POKéMON is said to represent the land. It went to sleep after dueling KYOGRE.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It had been asleep in underground magma ever since it fiercely fought KYOGRE long ago.
flavorText.platinum: It had been asleep in underground magma ever since it fiercely fought KYOGRE long ago.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: Said to have expanded the lands by evaporating water with raging heat. It battled titanically with KYOGRE.
flavorText.black-white: It had been asleep in underground magma ever since it fiercely fought Kyogre long ago.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It had been asleep in underground magma ever since it fiercely fought Kyogre long ago.
flavorText.x-y: Said to have expanded the lands by evaporating water with raging heat. It battled titanically with Kyogre.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Groudon is said to be the personification of the land itself. Legends tell of its many clashes against Kyogre, as each sought to gain the power of nature.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: RAYQUAZA lived for hundreds of millions of years in the earth’s ozone layer, never descending to the ground. This POKéMON appears to feed on water and particles in the atmosphere.
flavorText.emerald: A POKéMON that flies endlessly in the ozone layer. It is said it would descend to the ground if KYOGRE and GROUDON were to fight.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It has lived for hundreds of millions of years in the ozone layer. Its flying form looks like a meteor.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It lives in the ozone layer far above the clouds and cannot be seen from the ground.
flavorText.platinum: It lives in the ozone layer far above the clouds and cannot be seen from the ground.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It flies in the ozone layer, way up high in the sky. Until recently, no one had ever seen it.
flavorText.black-white: It lives in the ozone layer far above the clouds and cannot be seen from the ground.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It lives in the ozone layer far above the clouds and cannot be seen from the ground.
flavorText.x-y: It lives in the ozone layer far above the clouds and cannot be seen from the ground.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Rayquaza is said to have lived for hundreds of millions of years. Legends remain of how it put to rest the clash between Kyogre and Groudon.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: A legend states that JIRACHI will make true any wish that is written on notes attached to its head when it awakens. If this POKéMON senses danger, it will fight without awakening.
flavorText.emerald: JIRACHI is said to make wishes come true. While it sleeps, a tough crystalline shell envelops the body to protect it from enemies.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It is said to make any wish come true. It is awake for only seven days out of a thousand years.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It is said to have the ability to grant any wish for just one week every thousand years.
flavorText.platinum: It is said to have the ability to grant any wish for just one week every thousand years.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: Generations have believed that any wish written on a note on its head will come true when it awakens.
flavorText.black-white: It is said to have the ability to grant any wish for just one week every thousand years.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It is said to have the ability to grant any wish for just one week every thousand years.
flavorText.x-y: Generations have believed that any wish written on a note on its head will come true when it awakens.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: A legend states that Jirachi will make true any wish that is written on notes attached to its head when it awakens. If this Pokémon senses danger, it will fight without awakening.
flavorText.sword-shield: Once every 1,000 years, the singing of a pure voice will rouse this Pokémon from its near- perpetual slumber. It wakes for only seven days.

flavorText.ruby-sapphire: The DNA of a space virus underwent a sudden mutation upon exposure to a laser beam and resulted in DEOXYS. The crystalline organ on this POKéMON’s chest appears to be its brain.
flavorText.emerald: A POKéMON that mutated from an extraterrestrial virus exposed to a laser beam. Its body is configured for superior agility and speed.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: This DEOXYS has transformed into its aggressive guise. It can fool enemies by altering its appearance.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: An alien virus that fell to earth on a meteor underwent a DNA mutation to become this Pokémon.
flavorText.platinum: An alien virus that fell to earth on a meteor underwent a DNA mutation to become this Pokémon.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: DNA from a space virus mutated and became a Pokémon. It appears where auroras are seen.
flavorText.black-white: An alien virus that fell to earth on a meteor underwent a DNA mutation to become this Pokémon.
